title: Bateaux Mouches Seine River Paris by Night Dinner Cruise with Live Music
description: See the iconic sights of Paris from the water, illuminated for the evening, on this Bateaux Mouches sightseeing dinner cruise. Float leisurely down the Seine and take in unobstructed views of the Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame Cathedral, the Louvre, and other must-see sights while enjoying a 4-course dinner and live music.

reviews.usertext:
My partner and I spend 3 nights in Paris and doing a dinner cruise on the Seine was something I really wanted to do. It is very pricey but in my opinion it was worth it! And it is of course not something that you will do often.

We opted for the Excellence menu, the more expensive version, which resulted in us sitting at the very front of the boat. Which was amazing! We were sitting right at the glass and had a view at the side, front and top of the boat. The food was good and the waiter was friendly.

The roof deck is open the entire cruise, for even better views. We went by the Eiffel tower exactly when it started to sparkle, which gave us a beautiful view from the roof deck. A view that you will not get anywhere else around the Eiffel tower.

Halfway through the cruise a photographer came and took a few pictures of everyone who wanted. These pictures were printed on the boat and could be purchased for €15 per photo. A bit pricey but a fun memory to keep. The cruise was over before we knew it. The hours really went by quickly.

I don't really have anything negative to say about the cruise itself. The only thing that was a little bit annoying was that we could not get in contact with Bateaux Mouches after booking online. I tried three emails and also called but got no response. Luckily my questions wasn't a big deal, but if there were urgent things it would be inconvenient.

We experienced an unforgettable evening with beautiful views of night Paris. We booked the more expensive variant to be sure we would be sitting at the window. It paid off: the food was scrumptious, and the wine was excellent. We enjoyed the visit on the roof of the boat and were happy to go inside when it started raining.
The live music was excellent - piano and violing, a perfect match of jazz and classical music. There were many people on the board and it felt a little crowded, but overall the staff managed very well and was very pleasant.

Bought the tickets for myself and my partner, it was very good. The music was live and they performed all the time (piano and violins, very romantic). The food was also good, you get a whole bottle of wine for two people. Also the ambient is very classy and romantic, would recommend the experience to anyone!

Okay, first the positives. The food was great, artistically prepared, and very tasty. The cruise itself was wonderful, the Seine River at night is beautiful and of course the illuminated Eiffel Tower itself is breathtaking.

The service was okay, overall, but we had to wait at least 15 minutes after being seated to even be approached by a waiter, who was constantly attending to the tables all around us while ignoring us. After we flagged him down and expressed our displeasure the service did improve somewhat.

However, the main problem, which was entirely unacceptable and basically ruined the whole evening, was the temperature inside of the boat. It was at least 85 degrees in the boat and that is being generous. It literally felt like 100! There was a fan about three tables away from us which did absolutely nothing for us. So the temperature was stifling, there was NO ventilation, no breeze, not even an open window. We were literally surrounded by solid panels of glass which basically acted like a huge greenhouse. I assumed that the temperature would cool off as the evening progressed, but it never did, even long after the sun had set. It actually got hotter inside as time went on. I wasn't the only one noticing it, everyone was fanning themselves with whatever they could find. A gentleman at the next table was sweating so profusely that the elbows of his long sleeve shirt were soaked. After an hour or so I went up to the open upper deck to cool off and as I walked to the stairway I noticed there was a tiny portable room air conditioner in use and also a large open window, so management was aware that it was too hot but did very little to solve the problem.

I had hoped my wife and I would have a wonderful evening full of good memories to last a lifetime but it was impossible to have a good time with the unbelievably hot temperature inside the boat. And I am from Florida so I am no stranger to hot temperatures! So basically I spent over $300 to be hot and sweaty for two hours and fifteen minutes. There is absolutely no excuse for this. The boat should have been pulled out of service until the air conditioner was fixed. And this was mid-May, I can only imagine what it will be like on that boat in July!

A very disappointing trip along the Seine.
While I can fault the boat itself, nor the sights, which by night are spectacular, both of these could have been done much cheaper with any number of companies.
I paid for the Excellence dinner menu which seemed to offer the best choice. Sadly the execution of this was terrible.
Going for the Foie Gras, the lamb and the pecan cookie, only the desert course was any good. The Foie Gras was tasteless, three blocks of stodgy clay with a baguette. The abomination that was the lamb course was dry, tough and flavourless. A small round of over cooked lamb and a pea purée (which at least had some taste) and a tasteless sauce.

The music was incredibly over bearing; louder than any bar I visited in the city and when you’re a trapped audience, you have no where to go.
Our cheese course was missed by the waiting staff however the chaos that was the service meant that we didn’t both highlighting this; those guys were already over worked.

While a packed table of drunk American tourists is not the companies fault, however they could have been asked to tone down the shouting and raucous singing rather than some staff encouraging them.

The tables were crammed into space but thankfully we were at the front of the boat so did have a fantastic view.

Like I say, the tour itself is superb in the lights, however paying €130 for food that McDonalds could master, is ridiculous.

The boat ride itself was good, with an experienced guide and bilingual explanation, interesting sights etc. We paid for the more expensive gourmand option (with wine, cheese and cold cuts). However we were only given a bag of crisps and a small glass of wine

We started by Bateaux Mouches no longer sending us down the gangway to our boat but sending us out along the quay to walk for a long way in the baking sun to the boat with no guidance, many people queued for the wrong boat. After we had left we discovered that the air conditioning was not operating. We spent 2 1/2 hours on the boat at around 38 degrees, everybody, including staff melting in the heat. They have 6 restaurant boats, only 2 in use, this boat should never have been in service. We have used Bateaux Mouches around 25 times in the last 33 years but never again. This was supposed to be a re-visited romantic evening, instead it was miserable and annoying from start to finish. We actually ate off the cheaper € 99 menu this time. The fois gras was poor quality, the onion relish tasteless, the toast rock hard and inedible. The rest of the meal was OK but very late. They obviously had serious staffing problems in the kitchen. The sweet was finally served as we approached to dock at the end. They then served coffee immediately and had no milk for the coffee. The musicians did their best to be entertaining in a miserable boat. Disgusting, we will demand a refund. When we checked back at the hotel they said Bateaux Mouches are no good any more, use Bateaux Parisiennes or I think Croisieres. Bateaux Mouches are no longer charming and romantic, no information screens any more, just interested in money. If you used to use Bateaux Mouches like we did, don't, stop, go somewhere else.

This was meant to be one of the highlights of a three day trip to Paris but fell woefully short of expectations. Poor quality cuisine, cheap and nasty wine, and service that was both slow and hurried at the same time. The boat was late departing due to some sort of unseemly quayside row with another passenger and as a result we were not even offered coffee after dinner, just disembarked with undue haste. What a shame. The view of the sights from the river is superb but the whole experience was underwhelming and to be blunt over priced for the quality of food and wine delivered,

The cruise was planned a few weeks ahead, on the occasion of a wedding anniversary. The overall experience was very positive and would recommend it to everyone wishing to see Paris from a different perspective. Our cruise was at night, with dinner and live music (never actually saw the musicians, but the music was pleasant and romantic). It lasted roughly two and a half hours and was indeed a very nice experience. I would expect the food to be slightly better but given the fact that so many people are to be served simultaneously, it was more than good. The route followed enabled us to see most of the main sites in Paris, beautifully lit!

Absolutely beautiful evening, food was lovely, live violinists playing a variety of music, and our server very attentive, a gorgeous warm evening meant we were able to get some amazing pictures of all the attractions on the upper deck.
Our dinner was 3 courses with some canapés and glass of bubbly as we were seated, bottle of Evian water and lovely bottle of red wine on the table included too. A photographer came round taking photos of every group that wanted them, it was 15euros per picture, he took 3 pictures and we only chose the best one, he wasn't pushy at all though.
Highly recommend this cruise.

This was a wonderful experience and watch nicer than any boats or dinner opportunities in the area. It is a tad pricey compared to some of the other boats but well worth it. You can walk upstairs and take pictures but the dining areas lovely and especially pretty at night

The check-in process was easy. We had a lovely table next to the window and I noticed immediately that the glass windowed walls were clean, making the view and the photographs nice and clear.
The entertainment was excellent. A wonderful violinist and a piano player.
The food was also very good, as was as the champagne and our bottle of red wine.
We reserved the 7:30 time slot (boarding at 8 and departing the dock at 8:30) and the timing for the Louvre was perfect. All lit up and sparkling.
The staff was friendly and attentive.
The highlight was when an older couple danced in celebration of their 60 year anniversary.
The gentleman put down his cane, took his bride in his arms and did a gentle and romantic dance.
It was truly a lovely evening. ❤️🥂😊

We took 5 disabled young people, 4 who are wheelchair users, for an 18th birthday celebration dinner cruise for our daughter. The dinner cruise on board Zouave, their most accessible bateaux mouche was a huge success. Our daughter especially loved the live classical music and a personal serenade of Pachelbel's canon in D. The company really tried hard to accommodate our group's complicated and complex needs.

The event was in 2 parts. Arrival, check in, in fact everything up to the end of the starter. The musiicians, violin and piano, were excellent. Then there was a good 40 minute wait for the main course and another for the dessert. The boat was tied up when they were still serving. People who had finished were leavng while others were being served then the lights went up and tables were being cleared while guests were still waiting for dessert. Birthday candles were a total shambles in that they tried 3 times to get it right and the poor old fidder had to do his Happy Birthday routine three times over. This was a classic lack of resource, an undermanned kitchen and poorly trained staff. The evening was ruined.

A beautiful way to see Paris and enjoy what I had hoped was a quiet dinner.
Sadly a family of 14 with 5 undisciplined young boys (8-9 years old) sat behind us. Sadly there were 4 small tables of couples seated along the window whose evening was marred by their behavior. Kids can be a joy to dine with; these were not.
Food was very good and our servers were most attentive. Had that party not been aboard I would rate the experience a 5 star.
Until the end of the cruise we never heard the live music.

We were visiting friends who live in Paris for our wedding anniversary. They hadn’t done this boat trip and as it was a special occasion we booked the Excellence menu. We were one of the first to board so chose a table at the back that seemed less crowded as there were no middle tables. It was a lovely sunny day but the inside of the boat was a perfect temperature, even with the extended glass windows.
We were quickly served the initial glass of champagne and a mousse bouche before pitc5,course meal was served. Presumably as we were seated early we were served out started early, which was fine. As we had a bottle included for each couple we choose a both Kue of champagne and a bottle of red wine.
All four course were excellent. The boat trip shows Pais at its best. We went upstairs for a couple of phot opportunities, particularly when we were close to the Eiffel Tower.
The service we received was very good and included a special sparkling desert to mark out anniversary.
This is an expensive evening but we loved it and it was perfect for a special occasion.

To start or end a perfect holiday in Paris you have to do the dinner cruise on the Seine River, we had a romantic evening accompanied by excellent service and a delicious dinner, the starter, main course, cheese plate and dessert were fabulous.
The boat ride is quite a long one, taking in some of the city's famous landmarks along the river while listening to live classical music which makes the tour into a very romantic experience.
A bottle of water and a bottle of champagne for two was also included. The truth is that I fell even more in love with Paris with this highly recommended experience.

I bought my 17 year old granddaughter here as a graduation gift and this was one of her choices of activities. This was our first time in Paris but will not be the last and I would do it again.
It definitely was a highlight of our trip, the atmosphere, food and service were excellent. Passing the Eiffel Tower at 10 as it shimmer was spectacular.
The live music, piano and violin were enjoyed by everyone, and a great selection of tunes.

We were really looking forward to the dinner cruise with live music on our last night in Paris as we try to do a dinner cruise in every city we visit that has a river running through it.

Whilst the food was very good quality unfortunately the timeliness of service wasn't. After our starter we waited around 1.25-1.5 hours for our main course to arrive and due to this delay ended up eating our cheese course and dessert moored up back at the Pont d'Alma pick-up/drop off point. As we were already way over time for the trip we left before coffee was served.

The other disappointment was that the dinner cruise (according to the details we read before booking it) was supposed to have live music and didn't.

Overally I'd give the experience 3 stars but only because of the quality of the food and not for the quality of the service, which was lacking both in promptness and in keeping the guests informed of what was happening (as we were told nothing until we asked).

We arrived half an hour before departure. There is a check in office to pick up boarding tickets before you board your boat. Staff there were lovely. The maitre D in the dark suit who met us on boarding was stoney faced and did not crack a smile the entire evening. Definitely not welcoming, friendly or approachable. We had a lovely table at the window with a bottle of champagne waiting for us. We noticed that people were already eating and ordering. Our two male waiters were very nice and friendly but were having to do so many tables that there quite a wait between courses . These guys never stopped the whole time so they are definitely under staffed. The guys were rushing against the clock the whole time. We were given our desserts just before docking and had our coffee moored up against the parked cars on the quay. No milk or sugar offered. The cruise itself was very good and a fantastic way to see the Eiffel Tower illuminated. We really enjoyed the live music which was a piano player and a violinist. The photographer who came round was very nice and not pushy at all There is a top deck which people were going up to to take photos and enjoy the ambience. They really need to hire more staff and that would make such a difference. We paid £240.74 for two.

We wanted to do something for our 10th wedding anniversary that would be memorable and although it was we felt at 198 Euro that the experience should have been a lot better.

Our server had too many tables to look after which meant we never got appetizers and then forgot to take our order and we had to chase this up 45 minutes later. It's really frustrating when people who arrived after got their order before us.

The gaps between courses was too long and really dragged on as we were still eating at gone 10pm.

They offer tea and coffee but not until your back and had no tea which was annoying and surely once your back the evening is done.

The food was nice, I enjoyed it but I had meals elsewhere in Paris that were nicer at a cheaper price. The meal wasn't 99 Euros nice.

The views were good, background music and ambience was good and we did enjoy it but I just expected better for the money.

Honestly I cannot believe I paid £265 for this.
Incredibly poor choice of menu options. ‘Champagne’ was 100% prosecco. I got the vegetarian starter and it reminded me of aeroplane food. Main course was chicken supreme with potatoes. It was luke warm so I sent it back. The replacement was piping hot and clearly came straight from the microwave as the plate was roasting. Chicken was tough chewy and just tasted tangy and reheated. The potato cube was like eating a cube of pure butter. Disgusting. And to top it off we were right beneath freezing cold air conditioning. I asked twice if it could be turned off and they did nothing. Dessert was nice but tasted exactly like a blue ribband. Really let down by the experience.

The food was some what of a letdown. It was edible but nothing spectacular. The bread was hard and they didn’t have any butter. We tried the wine and it was warm. Because we didn’t like it, we did not have any other options for drinks without getting charged extra, besides our one bottle or water They need to change their policy because we had the option to switch the water for soda but not the wine for soda which makes no sense. But it wasn’t all bad, as the authentic of the boat and the views of the city and major tourist attractions was quite nice. We had a good view of the Eiffel Tower. However we basically just cruised the same loop twice. Overall a good experience with my wife, but things could have been improved considering how much it costs. Thanks for taking the time to read my review. I rarely do them

Had the most wonderful experience, staff were friendly, food was exceptional, and the live violinist really made for a stunning evening cruise down the Seine. A photographer came round and took pictures, which you could buy at the end for €15. Only slight downside is that the tables are very close together, so if you are looking for privacy then this might not be for you. Would recommend to anyone looking for a romantic evening dinner experience like no other!

Our first time in Paris and seeing the Eiffel Tower. We were so excited. We got there early. We checked in and they gave us our menus. so we sat outside and figured out what we wanted to eat while we waited to board the boat . There was 6 of us. Walking to the boat we were amazed at how nice the boat was... it wasn't our boat. The next boat (not quite as nice) was still nice... not our's. The 3rd boat was our's. Well, we were just grateful to have the experience. They walked us passed 2 really nice clean boats before taken us to our's which was older and not as tall and open as the others. We just laughed about it. We sit and go to order and they said we had the wrong menus. Waiter was kinda embarrassed. It took another 20 minutes (people were already getting their appetizers) to get our menus and then we were rushed to order. I would say food was ok. I think we pictured the upgraded menu and were disappointed with the downgrade. None of the food was worth remembering. I flagged down the manager to just let her know. She gave me about 15 seconds then said she would have to come back. We kept seeing her but she avoided our table. She never came back to talk to us. We know at that point there was nothing she could do. Overall just being able to see the Eiffel Tower light up at night was amazing. We also enjoyed the live music. Just wish it was continuous thru the whole cruise. I would do the cruise again, but maybe on a better boat.

All in all a perfect end to the evening, views of the major Parisian attractions were largely unobstructed. Prestige menu included options suitable for vegetarians in all courses. Experienced excellent service from our server, Javed, whose ability to speak English fluently put us at ease. The single fault in the evening was that the door staff at the reception for ticket redemption knowingly left us and a dozen other guests standing in the rain for over 30 minutes.

We booked this activity on January 4th for September 24 and paid 250 for 2 person, Windows sit at 6:15 and I got an email on August 19 that they canceled it and they have running it for 8:30. I was sure i don't want to cancel as the price will be so high 1 month close to activity, but there was only cancelation option, well tried to book the same thing. They don't even offer Windows sit but it 311 per person now, 622 instead of 250, well sure I didn't book with them .because they have the activity running so its not due to covid or whether or problems, its just after 8 months of having they money they are canceling to get more money! Never use this company.

One of the most enjoyable nights of my life. The boat is beautifully decorated, our waiter was very kind and dedicated to ensuring we had a pleasant experience as well as being very helpful and answering any queries we had about the food or the sights - all with a smile on his face. The live music is fantastic, very nice songs which are perfect for a romantic night with a loved one. The food is amazing and the same could be said about the wine and champagne. The timing and organisation of the staff is second to none, making sure we were right in front of the Eiffel Tower whilst it sparkled. The photographer captures brilliant photos of your group which you can purchase near the end. Very friendly and happy staff, beautiful boat, great food, gorgeous sights. 5 stars.

Ok so this group do a dinner and live music with an included bottle of wine and bubbles for a middle of the rage price. Think I payed about 130€ per person and it was money well spent. Fantastic service. Amazing food what a view. Make sure you get the "excellence package" to guarantee you get a window seat. It's well worth it.

the meal was very poor , I would think pre cooked and kept warm we each had the
guinea fowl ,it was very oily , the veg, roasted baby potatoes and one cherry tomato were dry and not at all pleasant, the menu stated one bottle of wine and one bottle of water per two people,there were three of us and were served with one bottle of wine and one bottle of water. so I make that half a bottle of wine and half a bottle of water short.. To no fault of the company the weather was bad ,and the water was high so the craft had to change it,s planned route so we had a teriffic sight of te Eiffel tower much of the rest was of industrial and builders sites.
so all in all rather a disappointment.

This is the perfect experience for a special occasion. We booked the excellence option for my mother in law's 80th birthday. It is more expensive but provides a better menu choice and half a bottle of champagne each in addition to the glass on arrival. The boat's windows allow a great panoramic view and you can go outside onto the top deck for photos. The food was very good and the live music was excellent. The only problem was the loud voices of the guests behind our table but it didn't affect our enjoyment of the trip as a whole. This was a magical experience which all three generations of our family enjoyed.

Overall a nice experience. There are many of these boats on the same dinner tour. A little overpriced for the quality of food served. Musical entertainment was very good, pianist and violinist. Directions to get to starting place on the river bank is not very clear but found it by searching the boat names that were there. The ticket place is a large building on the same spot where the boats are and only opens approx an hour before departure to collect your boarding passes from an online booking

My husband and I had a magical evening aboard the Bateau Mouche. The food was absolutely delicious, the service was fantastic, the music played by the string quartet was divine and the views along the Seine were magnificent. We could not have wished for a more perfect experience to celebrate our 25th anniversary. (Gliding past the sparkling Eiffel Tower while listening to the band play La Vie en Rose was unforgettable!) We will definitely do this again in the future.

My girlfriend and I really enjoyed this event. The starter and desserts were great, but the main course was average, based on the price you pay. Staff was very friendly and courteous. The amazing night time views of the Eiffel tower are a huge highlight of the trip. Definitely recommend this event.

It was great to view Paris from the boat. The live music provided by the pianist and violinist were spectacular. The food was brutal. We had the Prestige menu which is an upgrade and ordered the veal. It was beyond well done and inedible.

Just returned from a 5 night stay in Paris and this was by far our favorite experience from the trip. We were excited to see the Eiffel Tower lit up in all its majestic glory at night, along with the Statue of Liberty and honestly didn’t have high expectations for the food but we were pleasantly surprised that the food was actually fantastic. The service from the staff throughout the entire evening was attentive and impeccable. The boat itself was beautiful, modern and clean. This is an absolute must experience for those planning a trip to Paris. Highly recommend!

Such a lovely experience. The cruise was amazing and we loved the service and the food. We had a bottle of champagne and then chose to buy a bottle of white wine. It was really relaxing.
It is expensive but we felt it was worth it.

I was a little worried reading the reviews of this excursion after we had booked. Our experience was phenomenal! Our waiter, Wally, was amazing and super attentive. The food was absolutely delicious. The live music was beautiful. There were so many opportunities to go above deck and take in the beautiful nighttime views. We definitely recommend this excursion and will be doing it again in June!

We had a really lovely evening Our server Sacha spoke perfect English and pointed out some of the sights . The food was delicious My only criticism is the timings and the lack of commentary on the sights. We ate our starter at 8pm , our main at 10pm and dessert just before we returned at 10:45. Some people who got on just after 8:30 were still eating their main meal . The boat was supposed to depart at 8:30 and we left at 9:15 . Although you are given a little book with details of the sights it would have been nice if they had been pointed out as we went past We opted for the premium menu which was wonderful

The service on board was terrible and we have never experienced such rudeness and bad communication from staffmembers. We were 3 family members seated at the top deck. There was a huge 30 people group seated next to us and they were so loud and cumbersome that we couldn't hear each other and had to scream across the table in order to have a conversation. We spoke to the waiter and asked her to talk to the group to be a little more considerate as there were more people on this deck in this small area and all of the sudden she didnt speak English and would not let us talk to her supervisor. This totally ruined our experience and we had a terrible night which was supposed to be magical. When we left the ship we asked to speak to the supervisor and we have never experieced such disrespect and rudeness. The way he spoke to my family and I was horrible and he was not sorry at all. He could not care less that we had this horrible experiece and when we asked him to not seat families at the table we were sitting at when there is a large group he said that he will not listen to us because he does not care about the customers experience he only cares about making money. We want to tell our story so other people dont have to have this horrible excperience and have to be spoken to like this.

Service- 30 minutes without a drink. Serving red wine the wrong way. Struggling to get the cork out of every bottle at every table. No tasting of it at all.

Food - veal was tough, cold and dry. After dealing with the rich people first and finally getting our food, we were still hungry at the end of a four course dinner!

When booking it did not tell me the difference between a prestige and excellent. If I had knows that this means a different menu, more courses, faster serving and window seats then I would have payed the difference.

No live music

If it wasn’t for the top of the boat and see the lights, we wouldn’t have seen anything as we were sat in the middle of boat looking at the backs of people heads.

Was expecting something slightly tacky with every opportunity to overcharge any extra’s. The reception was perfect with a glass of Moët champagne with some amuse bouche then the four course dinner was exceptional, we’ll presented & served well. We ordered an extra bottle which was reasonably priced, & finished the evening off with a complimentary brandy. The bill came with just the bottle charge.
The cruise was lovely with PARIS shining in all its glory on a tranquil river. Best money I’ve spent in PARIS !

I travelled from England to Paris to meet my grandson and celebrate his engagement.

I booked the river cruise and meal to celebrate this special time with him and his fiancée.

We were seated by eight and had our starter.

Unfortunately our mains didn’t arrive until gone ten o’clock. Only three out of four of us got our meals, which were cold. Whilst waiting for the fourth meal we were told that they had run out of the beef we ordered and offered us fish, which we did not want.

We were then given a beef steak off of the other menu which was also cold.

By this point we were pulling back in at the end of our cruise.

The whole experience completely ruined the special evening that I had planned for the newly engaged couple.

We did ask to speak to a manager but no one came.

They were completely understaffed.

Disappointing and a waste of money is an understatement.

Just no effort at all put into this cruise. You get on board, they start giving you food (not good, but I don't really care about the food), boat starts moving, couple hours later you stop moving and you get off the boat. No information on what you're passing, no welcoming from a host (waiter says hi), no real entertainment (viloin on and off, but come on guys where is the fun?!?!), not even a we're back now get off the boat announcement. You just sit there for hours and wait for another course of food you really don't want to eat. The scenery is beautiful but you should definitely skip this and just go on a standard river cruise.

Bottom line is they just don't care. They will sell out regardless of if they put effort into it or not.

Very nice ambience. Most of what I ate was really good. I had the duck for my main course and it was a little tough, but the mashed parsnips were delicious. I saw other complaints about slow service but I didn't experience that at all. I opted for the excellence menu so I would be guaranteed a spot by the window, when we passed the Eiffel tower my waiter (sorry dont know his name) was nice enough to take a pic of me with it in the background. Wouldn't hesitate to do this cruise again or recommend it to others. I'm pretty sure it would be nicer to do in the spring/summer/fall so that viewing the monuments from upstairs would be a little more comfortable as far as the weather goes.

A Great Way to Experience Our First Night in Paris! The food, service, ambiance and music were exceptional in every way. It was a rainy night, but we were comfortably seated at a window table with outstanding views of Paris. The musicians were very talented and added a lovely touch to our evening.
Considering what was included, the price was very reasonable.
Only downside is that when we got off the boat, we could not locate a return ride to our hotel and spent a great deal of time securing a taxi at the nearest intersection. Given that it was rather late at night and taxis were difficult to find, that took away from what was overall a beautiful evening.

Overall great experience! The staff were very kind and helpful even when we had something odd happen with our reservation (our ticket had the August date I reserved but their system had a different date). We were still able to board and enjoy the meal and views of Paris. We boarded around sunset and got back during the night time. It was also very family friendly and we got to witness a couple celebrate their 10 year anniversary which was really sweet.

We were unable to go because of high waters in the river. Message was sent a little more than 24 hours before the actual booking. I would pick an activity that is more reliable to have a romantic evening. Just take a tour bus if you wish to go on the river like we did.

It was a beautiful evening, staff, musicians, other customers we spoke to were all very delightful. Loved singing and clapping to familiar songs and enjoying a laugh.
Food was delicious, wine was too. Loved the view of the Eiffel Tower and along the seine river.
Would definitely recommend it.

This was the highlight of our time in Paris. The meal was wonderful, plenty of wine and champagne, all of the courses were very good. The mood was very romantic and the staff very attentive. Note that we did go with "Premier" service, when you have a once in a lifetime dinner go all in.

You need to locate the ticket office first to collect your tickets and menus. No signage to tell you where it is situated.
We had a Saturday night dinner cruise with live music ( 2 musicians).
The boat was not very busy so it meant everyone could have a window seat .
The food was good. Starters and desserts much better than the main course which was underwhelming!
Wine and fizz included.
Would have been nice to have commentary pointing out places of interest rather than a map to try and read in the dark!!
A photographer comes around and takes a couple of photos. They then bring them back for you to buy. €15 each. A shame to print them all out then throw away those not bought.
Better to show you them on an iPad then print off those sold!
An enjoyable evening.

Great time!!it was a perfect nite..the food was better than expected very tasty and brought out very warm, the staff was very attentive the city lights were fabulous and of course the eiffiel tower lite up ..the seating was great with tables on the rail..you could see everything.thanks for a great nite!,,

This was one our highlights of our trip, such a magical experience. The food was excellent and lovely ambience. We left in day light and arrived at the Eiffel Tower just as it was lit up. The music was great and so was the service. Couldn't fault anything and thought it was real value for money. Would definitely recommend this

A long wait before boarding the ship only to find that the window seats had to be given according to the row and not the reservation. staff with little experience, dinner with low average quality( wine from 7 euros).
Promote live music. I recommend the cruise without dinner.

Nice trip on the river in a delightful environment very good food. I expected some guide telling us a bit about the monuments we saw, but that was not the case. Live music nicely played and lots of opportunities to take photos. At the hour we passed the Eiffel Tower to see the sparkling lights.

Was a fantastic trip. The dinner cruise is formal wear....but we missed that part and showed in a t ahirt and tanktop. They didnt blink and sat us anyway. Arrive early and enjoy the ambience . They hit the eiffel right as it twinkles at 10pm. Be upstairs so you dont miss it!!

What a beautiful atmosphere with delightful food on this evening cruise. I went solo but wanted a dinner music and to see some of the city at night. The staff was wonderful and attentive, the live music was beautiful and the views were amazing.

It was great to see the architecture of Paris at night. I don't think they had enough staff so it took a long, long time to get each course of our meal. I am a pretty big eater and the portions were quite small for the price. Everyone has their own table, so that was nice.

Walking these charming gardens with a knowledgeable and friendly guide like Doug was a highlight of our trip to London. The history was thorough and the conversation truly enjoyable. And the tea was divine. Highly recommend.

Paris at night, need I say more? It was a fun and enjoyable night with a nice crowd.
1 star taken off for the checkin process which had me going back and forth between the boat and the office to get tickets to board and my veal was overcooked. Brilliant night otherwise.

Going up on the top of the boat was magical. Upgrading to having a bottle of wine was great advice.
The time flew by and we couldn’t take enough pics!
We arrived at 7:30 for the 8:30 launch-Perfect timing.

This was a very nice excursion. Really enjoyed Paris at night from the river.
Check in was easy. We had an awesome table with great views. We were greeted with a bottle of champagne at our table. Plenty of time for Photos.
The music was very nice. The only thing that was so-so was the food. The main course that I had could have been better, the rest of the food okay.
We ordered the red wine for our table. It was a typical Rhône style red table wine that was a bit too fruity for my palette. But over all it was a great experience and I would do it again.

We chose Excellence type, and we super satisfied with this activity! What a lovely and romantic night in Paris!

**The boat departs at 8:20pm, but you'd better to get there before 8pm for windowside seats.

Staffs were so friendly. Food was served as a course - welcome snack, starter, main dish, dessert and coffee. You can choose a bottle of champagne or wine(red/white). We chose champagne. Live music was so romantic. There was a photographer who took 3 pics for each tables. After that, photos were printed out. You can either choose to buy it or not. Each photos costs 15euros. I bought one :) I highly recommend this event for your memorable trip to Paris.

This dinner cruise was absolutely amazing! My mom and I have done them elsewhere before & this by far was our favorite. The boat was very clean and well presented. There is a spiral staircase that takes you upstairs to an open floor top deck to view the sites. The dinner was delicious! There is certainly no lack of food. And every table gets their own bottle of champagne. There was a pianist and a violinist playing and they were very good. This is a great way to see Paris; I have been to Paris many, many times and I have never had views like this.

There was no direction to get to the boat and we received no help from the ticket booth. We arrived and I table was next to a pillion and the floor was shaking due to the engine and we couldn’t see one side. The waiter was overworked so there was long gaps between courses and could t keep up with taking orders and opening the champagne. The cheese course was nice but we only got one portion as they run out of cheese, but I complain to the waiter and magic some cheese appeared. However the views where amazing and we passed the Eiffel Tower at 10 when it sparkled which my wife and I enjoyed and felt romantic which was interrupted by the waiter who said food was ready. This happen on another occasion and food wasn’t ready. The food was nice and enjoyable.

Overall not great for the money, if I had to book again to get the same experience then I would book dinner else where and book a boat tour else where.

The trip up and down the Seine was enjoyable. The views were quite good, the music was nice, and the food was mostly good. We liked the appetizers and the desserts, but the entrees were overcooked. The wine we drink was quite good. Overall, the entrees were disappointing, but it was a worthwhile experience since we weren't on it for the food.

When booking this Cruise we did not really know what to expect .
What an outstanding night it turned out to be .
Great Food live music and top class staff .
All of these and also been able to see all the sights of Paris lit up as you Cruise along the River .
A night to remember .

The cruise was a great experience and a highlight of our trip. To see all the sights of Paris at night made it worth while. The food was great, service was excellent & the staff where all very friendly and very welcoming. I would highly recommend it.

I am so, so disappointed with my experience with Bateaux Mouches.
I booked a dinner cruise as a surprise for my partner’s birthday but when we arrived, we were told that the route had been closed because the river was too high due to rainfall. We were given two options: have dinner on the boat whilst it remained moored and stationary and take two tickets for an ordinary sightseeing cruise to redeem another time, or go away and return to have our dinner cruise on another night.

We weren’t very well going to turn around and go home to cook something at that time of the evening – as I said, it was my partner’s birthday apart from anything else - and having already spent 200€ on the dinner cruise, I wasn’t in a position to take us out for dinner elsewhere. So, we decided to have the meal there and then.

Presumably because some people opted to take the cruise another night, the boat was half empty, and between that and the fact that we were looking at the iron dock/stairs through from one side of the boat, there was a very strange atmosphere. The food was good, although the duck I had for my main course was almost completely cold, which I wasn’t impressed with, especially given the boat was only half-full. Even without the cold food, though, it was certainly not a 200€ meal.

Nor was it a 172€ meal, which is the value of the experience minus the value of the sightseeing cruise tickets (worth 13€ each). There is absolutely no way I would have paid so much money for such a mediocre experience, and I feel that neither one of the two options presented to us in lieu of what I had paid for were at all sufficient.

To add insult to injury, at least one other Bateaux Mouches dinner cruise passed us whilst we sat, stationary. As it left at the same time as our boat was scheduled to, I asked why this boat, clearly offering an identical experience, was able to go when ours was not. I was advised that we were on a slightly taller boat, so the regulations were different.

Apart from the fact that I was given an incorrect explanation on arrival, I was so upset and annoyed to discover that our misfortune was compounded by an arbitrary choice Bateaux Mouches made to allocate my reservation to a slightly larger boat. In my opinion, this makes the poor attempt at compensation even more inadequate.

I tried to address my dissatisfaction to Bateaux Mouches via email a couple of weeks ago, but I have received no response. I realise it was not their fault that our cruise could not go ahead as scheduled, but I feel like they should have handled the situation significantly better and I am left feeling somewhat cheated and very disappointed. It was intended to be such a special experience – I’ve certainly never spent so much money on a meal before – and it was a huge let-down instead.

When visiting Paris in the past, I would look at people cruising along the Seine in the Bateaux Mouches and chuckle, thinking, "why would anyone want to be trapped on a boat for a couple of hours, eating God knows what." Well, I'm a total hypocrite because I did just that last week in Paris.

My family vacation took place in late July this year. The heat wave in Europe absolutely had us worn down, so accustomed to the comforts of a Texas HVAC system were we. This was to be my daughters first time in Paris, and my wife and I opted to do some really kitschy things as a nod to her novice status as a tourist there. Back in May, I booked a Bateaux Mouches cruise through TripAdvisor because I knew we would need someplace to eat our first night there and this would take care of seeing sights, getting a flavor of the city, and ensuring a table.

We arrived to a 90˚F Paris and were dreading the next several days there. Luckily we had food to look forward to. When we arrived, the boat was not ready, but they had our menu ready to peruse so that we could make our choices before boarding. My French is schoolboy French and was not of very much use, but I found none of the condescension that American visitors normally complain of. The staff were pleasant and greeted us in English.

We began with an amuse bouche and a glass of champagne, followed by our starter choice. I enjoyed my starter despite the atmosphere in the boat, which was sweltering due to the heat outside. I would imagine this to be a cozy atmosphere during the fall or winter months. The piano player and violin player began their entertainment and our main arrived around the time that the boat pulled away from the quay.

I enjoyed all of the food we had, and my favorite was, surprisingly, the cheese course. Morbier and St. Valentin cheese accompanied a very small salad. Combined with a lovely wine from Menetou-Salon, everything paired up beautifully.

It was about this time that I began to relax and notice the people lining the banks of the river, eating picnics of wine and cheese, and waving to us as we passed by. This was a way I had not seen Paris, and it trumped all of my previous conceptions of it. There was no obnoxious guide telling us about what we were passing. It was just a lovely boat ride at dusk in one of the world's most beautiful cities.

I like to think that when I travel, I try to find unusual experiences, so that is why I was so surprised at my reaction to this experience. I would never have pictured myself there, and yet, there I was. I am reminded of my mother-in-law's words to me: they call them 'attractions' because they are precisely that.

I left the boat buzzed, satisfied, and thinking about my next time to visit the Bateaux Mouches.

We booked to go to Paris for our wedding anniversary.
What better than an evening river cruise with Dinner and live music.
The day before our trip when we had just arrived in Paris we received an E mail to say that the cruise would not happen, because of river conditions,but Dinner would be provided on the boat. This was not good news and we were not impressed.
We arrived early and from the moment we set foot on the gangway there was an army of staff, just to make sure we were safe boarding the boat, who could not have been more pleasant. We went to reception who took us through the paperwork and gave us
a compensation offer for the future.
We were taken to our table with a wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower(unfortunately with the top in cloud. Not their fault). Orders were taken drinks were bought
The food was lovely, the staff were attentive and friendly, the boat was warm and the music was just right. Looking at the speed of the river we were glad that we weren't
moving. We were, however, able to watch every hour the Eiffel Tower sparkling.
We really enjoyed our "cruise" and don't think they could have done more to make up for the weather. When we left the same staff looked after us all the way to the shore.
Thank you

We paid the highest price for food and service, $130 PP. Turns out you need to be first in line 45 minutes ahead to get the earliest tables which are at the head of the boat or facing each other. We were 15 minutes later, one half hour early and found ourselves on line for more than 30 mins to board and were served last. FYI it feels like you are on line for a club with bouncers, we had to check with people around us that we were all bound for a boat ride with dinner.
If you miss the first on board, tables at the front you will be seated side by side, in tight quarters. We had a couple behind us that became irritated with the slightest movement. The food was good and bad. The appetizers were fab, crab cakes open faced. The mains which we chose were awful. Prime rib ordered rare for me and medium for hubby. Both were awful. Never got to dessert, we went topside and ignored. The white wine was terrible the red OK.

We both adored the trip and the views.Would truly suggest another higher end carrier or taking a picnic down onto the Seine alone. We envied the students and people dancing on the sides. Will do that ourselves if in Paris again, with luck.

We are a couple, who love high end experiences and were hopeful, but let down. Hope this helps.

As other reviewers have mentioned, pure chaos. Arrived when we were told to then told to sit and wait for over an hour without any access to a beverage. Our food was mediocre and the service was rushed. My salmon & blintzes appetizer arrived without the blintzes so had to flag someone down to bring them. The prime rib had literally been slapped on a flat top grill and charred. It was the toughest prime rib I ever had. We both ordered the molten chocolate cake but only received one. As other guests have reviewed, our coffee was served after we docked. Further, they turn the volume of the music up so LOUD when they dock that you have to leave the boat whether you have finished your meal or not. BUT the real capper for this experience was when we ventured upstairs to take a picture, I left my purse hanging on the table on a purse hook, AND our server came along to clear our plates and spilled red wine all over my white leather purse. He didn't even take ownership of it. When we asked the table next to us if they saw what happened they told us. So we called him back and he weakly apologized. We spoke with the manager who said they would email us to rectify the situation and that was 8 days ago. So far, nothing from the management. VERY disappointed but hopeful that the management will do something about the damaged purse.

I so nearly didn't book this reading some of the reviews but my friend and I, plus teenage daughter really enjoyed it. Obviously it is a put together package; it's not Michelin star but on the whole I think they try hard to make it enjoyable. The starter and pudding were really good, ok, the main course wasn't great - but it was really lovely cruising down the seine, monument and people watching. The accompanying drinks menu was just right for us so we didn't need to order anything extra.The fact you can go upstairs at any time to the fresh air with plenty of room everywhere meant we never felt herded in any way. The pianist and violinist playing were top notch. I would recommend dinner as obviously to go from daytime to night is lovely. The Eiffel tower was looking far more lovely when we passed it at night than it did in the heat of the next day. Staff all seemed very pleasant to us. Definitely worth the money, worth an evening.

This was definitely a good way to see the city. I will start off with the good points of this dinner. It’s a very nice boat (especially compared to all the other dinner boats you see on the river), tables nicely set, and nice staff. The food was different and good (mainly because we don’t eat this kind of food everyday). I would have expected mind blowing food for the price though, wasn’t bad, but wasn’t 100€ a person good. We got very full off this 5 course meal. Wine was delightfully good. Nice music (piano and violin). Great views on the top deck. Very nice and romantic dinner. Now just a few negatives from this ride. It was definitely not a 3 hour cruise as advertised. The band played music for 30 minutes, took about an hour break, played for 20 minutes, then another break, and played like one more song before the ride was over. It was good music and I definitely understand they need breaks between sets, but an hour break? Cmon. And finding the location was very stressful. Traffic here is absolutely terrible, finding the place was a nightmare, and then finding parking was rough. Overall.. was a very good time and pleasant dinner, but a little overpriced for what you get (duration, quality of food, and stress of location). I would recommend if you have the money and want to see the sights.

Everything was perfect. The costumer service was really good. they were so kind. The waiters amazing and really friendly and polite. Cozy. They had a perfect english and some spanish. Even the man guard, the security man was so nice with us. All of them were as well so funny.
I want to personally congratulate all the staff, because it was such a wonderful experience.
We definitely are going to repeat, we can not wait!
We had a dinner PRESTIGE where the food and main courses were incredible! The wine, champagne, desserts and coffee.
As well the live music... such a dream. No words for the pianist... and for the violinist!!!
This dinner cruise was a complete ripoff . There was No live music. Very Low grade food and terrible service! I do not recommend
Still no refund and very little contact. I was due to travel in April. YOU STILL HAVE MY MONEY! I want it back NOW!!!

This was one of our best nights in Europe. My wife and I spent about 13 nights in Europe, staying in Greece, Italy and France. This was easily one of our best nights. Boarding the boat was easy. They brought us directly to our table which offered a great view off the port bow. Our waiter took a little bit to get to us(he was covering 8 tables, one of 10+guests), but once he did, he was extremely friendly and never missed a beat. He quickly brought us champagne and refilled our glasses several times throughout the night. The boat got underway exactly on time. We began the trip down the river and were quickly served our appetizers. I got the Foi Gras and my wife got the lamb. Both were very tasty. For entree, I got the duck breast which was cooked to perfection and my wife got the scallops. We both enjoyed our dinners. We basically missed the cheese course as we went topside to enjoy some of the beautiful views. The dessert came with about 15 minutes left in the cruise. We enjoyed it prior to departing. The boat docked precisely on time. Overall, the live music was very fun, the sights were outstanding, the food and drinks were great and the service was amazing. I would not recommend this for children as they may be bored, but definitely would recommend for adults, especially couples looking for a romantic night in Paris.

I know lot of negative reviews are written here, and I agree with them to some extent; they are under staffed hence the level of service however I would still encourage you all to try. We went up the boat and took some beautiful pictures. Overall I had good time except for the understaffed service.

Cruise included 3 food courses, champagne and a bottle of wine. We were seated at the forward-most table so we probably had the best view on the entire boat. Table for 2, we had cold pea soup and crabmeat ravioli for apps. They took a while so we were also given complimentary foie gras. My first time - an interesting and tasty bite of food. Duck breast w/ potatoes and black risotto w/ confit tomatoes. Sorbet trio and berries & yogurt for dessert with brandy and espresso. Waiter did not speak much english but it wasn't a problem. Pianist and violinist played jazz and pop standards. Boat had an upper deck which was a nice break to see the sights from the water. Views and experience were really great. Food was good but not outstanding.

We've just come back from an extremely enjoyable evening. The dress code was smart casual (although some took the casual too literally!) but it didn't take the elegance out of the evening. The music set the scene for the lovely evening ahead (pianist and violinist).
The service was amazing and the staff spoke extremely good English and were very attentive.
The food tasted delicious, although I'm now full up on bread rolls....
I would definitely recommend the later time for dinner (we boarded at 8pm)as on the way back down the river the evening had set in and the Eiffel tower looked amazing all lit up.
At the end of the evening, I would recommend pre booking a taxi to pick you up as walking along the cobbled street in heels trying to find one is a bit of a nightmare.
My husband I thoroughly enjoyed our evening.

Normally I avoid meals at landmarks and on boats however being Paris I thought the food would be better. It was an excellent four course meal and they made a special effort to deal with my daughters dairy allergy.
The live music was a special extra and did not dominate. The Seine and Paris lit by night were the real stars of the night.
Excellent value as the price included an aperitif and a bottle of wine between two.

Having been to Paris many times we had never taken a Bateaux Mouches trip, far too many tourists we thought. Yes of course along with all the major attractions of this beautiful city the Bateaux Mouches are high on the tourist agenda. This full-on dinner trip, on Boxing Day, was a great surprise, not cheap but the whole experience was one not to be missed. The service, food and wine were excellent and the staff could not be more attentive.which is all the more surprising as this is really purely a tourist attraction, but the guests seemed very well behaved and not at all what one normally expects from this sort of tourist attraction. Seeing all the familiar sites from the river was memorable. Highly recommended, particularly if you, by chance, get the best table right at the front of the boat.

This was my fourth Seine cruise but my first on Bateaux Mouches (concierge erroneously told us it was similar to Bateaux Parisiene which was booked) . The boat was only about 25% booked so when they sat us at a cramped table with severely obstructed view, I requested another. The host refused but a manager instructed him to move us- which he did with poor attitude.(They attempted to seat another couple there but they complained as well) The boat was extremely warm- We were baking. The food was horrible but we expected this. There was no entertainment at all. Worse, there was absolutely no narration or guidance on what we were seeing.. None. Service was hurried and it seemed like they couldn't wait to be rid of all of us. The tables were insanely cramped. Compared to Bateux Parisiene, this experience was FAR INFERIOR. While Bateaux Parisiene has equally horrible food, the boat is clean and comfortable, the entertainment and experience superior, and overall a MUCH MUCH better experience. This was my new husband's first trip to Paris and this cruise was a HUGE disappointment. Don't waste your money.

Having enjoyed this tour in 1983 and 2008 we had expectations of a great experience. Not so much in 2018. We selected the premium dining package (wider selection of dishes and better wines). Well the selection didn't really matter because all dishes were bad. The rib-eye was so stringy and tough that it was inedible. Same with the lamb which was a slice of loin so overcooked it tasted like liver. Wines were mediocre but better than the lower graded dinners. This may have to do with the 'boat' they put you on. We were on the Mouche. On previous trips we had access to the uncovered section of the main deck (aft). On this boat the access was upstairs on the roof. The boat went so fast that we arrived back at the dock and dessert had not yet been served! Will never use Bateaux Mouches again. Try Bateaux Parisien perhaps or the new Alain Ducasse (much more expensive) cruises.

I booked this for three of us - was able to do so on the day. There was no real information about what to do pre-cruise, i.e. there is a bar onshore you can use (although the waiter disappeared and then couldn't supply two of the three requested drinks!). Onboard we had a great table next to the windows. My main disappointment was that there was no real consideration for non-drinkers. I am not a child and do not want to drink fizzy soft drinks or fruit juice when my companions are having champagne and wine. I was not the only person onboard to request non-alcoholic drinks - a virgin cocktail instead of champagne and even non-alcoholic beer would have shown some consideration. Instead I just got water - not a great deal for 99 euros). The service was friendly but sloppy - our mains sat on the central serving table for ages while the waiter reread order slips and looked confused! This was repeated with our desserts and meant our lava cake had dried up. The views and the musical accompaniment were wonderful but the quality of service really needs to be improved.

The trip was almost a disaster as the signage on arrival was poor - we went into the main ticket office, gave the girl behind the counter our e-ticket confirmation, she kept them & handed over two small tickets - for the normal cruiser. Luckily we realised our mistake (no tables) and went to find the correct gangway further down. Why the girl in ticket office didn't say anything is a mystery.
Having got on the correct boat, everything went smoothly. The food was served at just the right pace & each course was pleasant enough. The banks of the Seine glittered and the highlight of the view of Eiffel Tower was a tourist's delight.

Overall a very good evening, although probably a little over priced.
I'd agree with some of the other posters that the food is nothing special, but that's not really surprising when mass catering is involved. Under those circumstances it's actually quite good, but it would certainly be better if there were less guests on board - I'd hate to be on a trip that's full. On my trip there were quite a few empty seats but it still seemed a bit of a struggle for the crew to get all the food served in time. If you board early, as we did (before 8pm) you'll get your starter before the ship has even left the dock! (There's no reason to board until it's about to sail, at 8:30pm).
Most people had made the effort to dress appropriately - 'business casual' I'd call it, Maybe those few that turned up in scruffy jeans and t-shirts had lost the luggage when traveling to Paris? Or maybe they were just ignorant? Either way, at least they had some sort of excuse which is more than can be said for the couple near us that had a young baby, and another who brought aboard a toddler. Don't they realise that's what the lunch time cruise is for? Anyway, for the most part the trip passed peacefully and was very good.
One thing that did annoy me a little was that a photographer took pictures of everyone, but to buy them was 15 Euro each. Considering the cost of the trip I think they could include maybe one photo as part of the package.

WOW !!!! This was a truly fantastic evening from the moment we boarded to a glass of champagne & nibbles to the food and wine to the the beautiful cruise. It was my daughters 19th birthday & she was surprised with a cake with sparklers & played to by the fantastic live musicians. The whole trip was beyond our expectations as it was a perfect hot evening which started in the light and then we cruised back to a sparkling Eiffel Tower & all the flood lit buildings. The staff were polite & friendly & honestly struggled to do enough to make the night memorable with their hospitality. Been on some great trips and ate at some lovely restaurants but this surpasses everything and I would definitely recommend it to anyone seeking a special occasion memory.

Arrived in Paris on the Friday and had this booked for the evening wow what a beautiful trip everything was perfect the greeting of fizz and the meal was lovely. Would like to say a big thankyou to our two girl waitresses sorry did not get your name but thankyou for looking after us. Would highly recommend this trip five stars from us.

I don't know how this company stays in business. There was pure chaos from arrival to departure. There was no directions where to board the boat. After finding our way to the boarding pass area, we were told we were on a different boat than the one that was boarding. We were to meet friends and asked for a table for 4. This was met with disdain, It was not possible to put 2 tables for 2 together and make a table for 4, even though the tables were placed one in back of the other and the seats could be moved easliy. The staff was rushed and we were served coffee as the boat was docking. I will NEVER recomend this dinner cruise to anyone. No one who worked there seemed to know that their job was to do whatever they could to make a pleasant experience for the clients.
Our trip was cancelled due to high water levels on the Seine. Despite making several phone calls and emails I still haven’t received a refund 3 weeks later. Very disappointing.

We booked the Bateaux Mouches' Seine River late evening dinner cruise before we left the States. Simple and easy. Why Bateaux Mouches? Our hotel was off the Champs, and I was looking for a cruise dock in walking distance. Bateaux Mouches hit mark; only 12 minutes from our hotel by foot, or 12 minutes by Metro. Highlights of the evening: The river was beautiful, the dinner very good, the wait staff wonderful (at least 70% spoke excellent English), the included wine and champagne just kept flowing, and desert with Notre Dame in the background made everything perfect. The trip was planned to be at the Eiffel Tower at 11 PM, when the Tower is aglow with thousands of individual lights. It was beautiful. Hint: There are 2 levels of dining, Prestige and Excellence. We had the less expensive (at about $110 each) Prestige dinner. While the cost was less, the level of service and enjoyment was equal, with no noticeable difference. Also, it did not seem to matter what you ordered in your seating, as that seemed to be randomly assigned. Lots of 2 person tables on the "glass"--including us. We left happy, excited and pleased.

Overall the event was...okay .
We arrived on time and went to collect our boarding passes..there was a system error which delayed things a little, no problem.
It was only later, when boarding, that we found out the tables were on a first come basis. I would have thought it would be better to have a set table with the menu booked in advance .
There seemed to be no start to the evening, we boarded and people were eating..some still on main when we ended the tour..could have had a welcome once everyone was aboard and a brief intro to the tour.
There wasn't really any guidance on when food was served and where on the river you were.
That being said, the food was alright and you could go updeck to the roof.. in fact, it was that hot in the cabin that you needed to. No open windows or AC meant it was very humid and around 35-40dc on board. The musicians made the night great though, upbeat and lively..provided a great end to the night.

For the hundreds paid, I'm disappointed...had I paid much less it would have been pretty good...id advise going to a nice restaurant, then going on a cheaper sightseeing boat trip😁

This was a highlight of our trip. Cruising down the Seine at night while viewing the sights of the City of Lights with wonderful food and music was lovely. Our waiter, Alex, was very attentive and we enjoyed also meeting some of our fellow passengers on the top deck while taking several great photos of the landmarks,
This was a memorable evening..

This cruise was brilliant, the food and wine were excellent and the whole evening was such good value. The waiter was great fun and really looked after us. We were celebrating our friends birthday and when they found out they arranged happy birthday candles and gave them both a great gift; a book on the history of Bateaux Mouches. I think the evening was a highlight of our whole trip. A wonderful way to view the Eiffel Tower lit up.

Hi guys - just wanted to share our experience at the bateaux mouche dinner cruise in Paris.

My girl friend took me here for dinner on our last night in Paris. Firstly when we arrived, we were informed that the engine of the boat malfunctioned and the boat would be stagnant so that itself was a bummer since we wanted to do a cruise and see all the marvellous sights of Paris.

We still went ahead with the booking. Once we got to the boat we were presented with a set menu. The food was super bland and insipid , the bottle of red wine offered to us was so dry and dull. There was no way we could finish it!

The only thing that was sub par was the desert, not at all impressed by this place. Infact we fell ill the next day with the food and alcohol served to us.

Better to avoid this place, there are way better food and drink places this city has to offer!

I bought my tickets on Viator - issue No.1. The tickets did not say get there an hour early because you'll be sent to stand in a queue with 1 person at the ticket booth, then sent on to another ticket booth prior to boarding. I found this very stressful as we had gotten there half hour prior to boarding as recommended but found ourselves worrying that we were either going to miss it or be assigned rubbish seats because we were the last on board.

As it turns out, we indeed were given rubbish seats. They have a very small number of second rows of tables, i.e. not alongside the window, which we were shown to. I refused our table (I was a little in madam-mode at this point as I was already stressed about the ticket process and being made "late") and was eventually shown to a window seat at the top end of the boat. Very unfair I felt, if this table was available, why were we fobbed off with the secondary table originally? I should not have had to cause a fuss to get what we paid for. Who takes a cruise to sit in the middle of the boat?! I can understand that the tables are there for larger parties, so that 4 can sit together, but we were a two, being sat next to another two, who we could hardly crowd and take photos over whilst they were eating. Not to mention the table was in a through-way and we'd have been avoiding elbows for the most part.

Anyway. We were moved, end of story, but with that and the ticket experience, the first half hour was not pleasant at all and I found myself regretting booking it.

The food was nice, I had the crab and avocado starter, my other half had the pate which I would have next time, as it was lovely. The main was nice, as was the cheese and desert. Not ground breaking but pleasant enough. We were asked if we were there for any special occasion, which we said no, just a weekend trip, but this somehow translated to us being wished a happy anniversary with a sparkler in our desert at the end of the trip alongside several other couples, which was funny.

Would I do it again? Yes, I think overally I was happy with it, the cruise was lovely, the boat was nice and the food was fine. I think it could all be taken up a notch but then you'd be paying more for the pleasure so, as it stands, perfectly acceptable.

Would recommend two things, that you make sure you get there at least an hour before if you don't have your boat tickets, and that you don't take "no" as their final answer on seating, as had we been left at the first table, we would have had a markedly different opinion on the trip.

The scenery on the dinner cruise was spectacular, arriving at the Eiffel Tower was the flashing lights began at 10:00 pm. The food was very good but the service lacked at times. We were not even asked about coffee until docking at the end of the cruise. Overall we would recommend this cruise for couples or families.

We booked Bateaux Mouches dinner cruise on our last night in Paris.
What a fitting way to finish Paris.
Great food and service by all the staff.
Enjoy all courses served while cruising down the Siene with the sun setting and watching Paris light up and making sure you are passing the Eiffel Tower when it's light shows begins on the hour.
Well signed and easy to find the location of the cruise.
Highly recommend whilst in Paris.

We have been doing the Dinner cruise on the Bateaux Mouches for nealy 30 years the last one being about 3 years ago and as always been part of our itinerary when in Paris.
However it has definitely lost its sparkle and is no longer worth the 99 euros per head!
We were served aperitif, amuse bouches and entree whilst still moored at the dock.
Atmosphere was lacking and with only a prerecorded CD violinist which was too lound and painful. Aleays had a live musician in the past.
Service was good but the food very average and the wine poor.
It wasnt particularly clean and some of the waiters were also poorly turned out. The toilets are just awful so avoid them.
Its such a shame that this has gone down hill and the empty seats on a Saturday night in Whitsun holidays says it all!

Booked this for our first night in Paris. The cruise had a lot of great reviews, particularly about the food. Usually dinner cruises are not our thing, but we took a chance and it was worth it. We had a wonderful corner window view of Paris, and the food was solid. Not 5 star, but well done. The best part though was the deck on the top of the boat. How can you beat cruising down the Seine at night in a city truly made of lights. The crew was also fantastic and the music a night touch. It wasn’t overly crowded which also made for a nice time. Definitely worth the time to check this out, especially if you are looking for a relaxing and romantic evening.

The pictures looked great, the price looked great and the reviews looked great... It was better than great! The food was brilliant the atmosphere with the live music was fantastic and the whole experience was truly amazing. If I am ever in Paris again this will be the first thing I book!

We chose to spend our last evening in Paris on this delightful dinner cruise. We had a table to ourselves, with a great view of the lights along the river. Our server was excellent and the music was lovely. Dinner was good and the wine was great. A wonderful, romantic end to our Paris adventure!

This was booked as a company event but our party of 50 were spread over 6 tables and mixed amongst other diners. The main was pre-ordered but the starter and dessert just came with no choice and the starter was foie gras which is always a controversial choice. The food was ok but the whole experience was let down by very disorganised staff who didn't seem to have a clue. The Director who had booked our trip spent most of the evening trying to get some wine on the table (it arrived by the second course!) and what should have been a fun evening was rather stressful and a bit of a disappointment. We eventually gave up on the food and spent a delightful evening on the top deck enjoying Paris by night. If it hadn't been for the view and the beauty of Paris my review would have been much lower. My advice is eat in a restaurant where you'll get much better food and wine and go down the river on a regular boat and enjoy the sites.

My husband and I went on a dinner cruise as a birthday gift for my husband.
We arrived at the boat and were shown to our table.
The food was varied and tasty.
The wine was lovely.
Throughout the evening there was live music which was great.
The scenery was great whilst we ate our dinner.
A really worthwhile experience.

i been prepare surprise for my girlfriend just too spend time together , i reserve the trips i didn't expect that its was more then my expectation ,
first all the hotesse been really professional, courtois , polite , smiling ect,,
the bateaux was clean nice atmosphere ambiance amazing ,all the staff was officient and great the food was excellent , foie gras was delicious and the fondant au chocolate oh goodness its was delicious i was scare when i choice it but it coming really the way i like it , the music was great its been one of the most important moment i been spend i dont have any regreets, too finish the photograph been very officient i have nice picture like memory ++ the memory i have in my mind, thanks you too all the staff you guys make this night so special and memorable

Did a dinner cruise many years ago that was fabulous, and thought this would be a repeat. Not so. Without warning the tour didn't go down river towards Notre Dame because the river was too high for the bridges. Instead they killed time going up river to the industrial area, so we got cement trucks and factories instead of Ille Cite, etc. The main course was only average, and noise from the waiters stations spoiled the music. Staff were courteous and friendly and our waiter was excellent, but all in all a big disappointment.

The cruise down the Seine was very nice. We had plenty of space and were not crowded at all. The dinner left a bit to be desired. We realize this is more about the experience, but the dinner is also part of that. I do not know if our waiter was new or flustered, he was nice enough, but forgot much. Check the menu before you go. I am sure the food offerings change. Over all, it was not bad. I am not sure I would pay for this again however.

If you are not a spoiled "foodie" you might actually like the meal you receive as you cruise slowly past the fabulous Bridges and monuments of Paris. However if you ARE a spoiled foodie just be aware that both the cuisine and the service are just okay. The reason this is such a great experience (and it is) is because there is no other way to get this perspective of so many of Paris's great monuments, especially when they are all lit up at night.
The boat itself has exterior lighting which they switch on to light the bridges and darker areas as you float past.
I have been to Paris many times, but I never really saw the details of the bridges until I took this cruise.
They timed the dinner cruise so that we passed the Eiffel Tower just as it began to sparkle (as it does every hour on the hour) and it really covered the length of the city and all it's important sites and monuments with great views from both sides so it didn't matter which side (of the boat) you sat on. It cruises up the river and then back down, so both sides get the direct view either coming or going.
The live music was the perfect accompaniment to the dinner and the views, consisting of a pianist and a violinist. FYI, that is included in the price of your ticket.
