I didn't see a tip jar, and being an American I appraoched the musicians at the end if the tour to compliment them and give them each a small tip. They looked at me with a look I couldn't distinguish but now believe was disdain. They are professionals and my gesture seemed almost insulting to them, as if they were playing in a college bar or something. Anyhow I read peie pretty well and that was the impression I got, so just FYI. Don't tip the musicians. The servers are all young people who seemed more than happy to receive a tip.
Also, no need to que up at the boat to "score" a better seat. On these boats every table is along the glass exterior wall so every seat has the same view.
We dusthink it would be superior at the front if the boat but upon boarding we're stweredtothe mid section by the crew and informed that this few tables in the front were "at a different price point" (I'm assuming the upgraded menu). If the food was coming from the same kitchen I can't imagine it would be much better just pricier!
Go for the views and the experience, at least once while you are in Paris.
Go elsewhere for a special and memorable meal.

The service was very very slow and the food quality very disappointing especially the main course which was cold and very dry like it's been waiting for a long time to be served after cooking.. the menu "excellence" absolutely overpriced..

In Paris for wife's 50th birthday and booked the Prestige Dinner Menu. Took a taxi to the departure point near to the Pont de l Alma bridge. They've got a big venue there on the riverside and you can't miss it.
You go into their main office, check in and they point you in the direction of the boat you've been allocated. There was several cruises departing at the same time, however the boats names are very conspicuous and easy to spot.
Boat itself was lovely, all the tables for four were down the outside giving splendid views, whilst down the centre were the two seated tables.
Waitress was very attentive and poured a glass of bubbly for us as soon as we sat down and then took our order.
We had barely started moving and our starter was served, so I was a little concerned that our meal would be over and done with and we'd only just set sail. However, there was quite a gap between servings, which really spaced out the meal and there was a bottle of wine per couple as we enjoyed the views.
The cruise itself was perfect, all the young Parisians and tourists seem to gather at evening time on the banks, drinking beer and wine, chatting amongst themselves and enjoying the warm summer evening - it was truly romantic and enjoyable to see.
The cruise itself does last about two and a quarter hours, but it never seems to drag. There is no onboard commentary, but that was a good thing. There was a violinist to add to the ambiance, whilst a pro-photographer took some photo's which you could purchase if you wanted.
Yes, it's quite pricey, but we felt it was well worth it. The boat was spick and span, the staff were so helpful and the meal was delicious.
TIP 1 - We berthed about 10.50pm and if you hang around till 11pm, the twinkling lights of the Eiffel Tower come on for a few minutes and you can a great view.
TIP 2 - Arrive sharp, the queue to initially check in can get quite long.
No live music and terrible food (low quality, cheap, cold). I would really advise to do only the tour and eat in a correct restaurant at a much better price.

Had a lovely dinner and romantic evening largely thanks to the musicians and staff aboard the boat (the boat was very clean and nice also). Only negative was that the tour didn’t take on many of the sites promised.
Excellent night. Information given on where to go and how to tickets was very clear. Definitely recommend others to use you for booking
We can highly recommend this dinner cruise, food was delicious and service great and the view magical.

This was a terrible experience. We paid 99 euro's each for bad food, bad wine and champagne and unfriendly staff. + we didnt get to see most of the monuments. (Only eifeltower and statute, the rest was banlieu) When i asked for an explanation they were really rude and not helping at all. When i got off i felt sick of the food served to us. I cant believe this is getting good reviews as all the other people were queuing to get of the boat!!! As i said before : terrible.

It was worth the cost. Great food, great timing on spreading out the courses along the cruise, nice ambiance. Just get your own picture taken with your own phone once clock strikes on the hour to get Eiffel Tower sparkling because once you turn around & the boat’s photographer comes around it may not be sparkly. FYI the wine only comes by the bottle, can’t buy it by the glass.

We met our guides right next to the Eiffel tower, between the cafe and the souvenir store. The staff were too friendly, Maria rocked! In our luck we didn't have trouble getting in as the lines were very very little! Totally recommended if you want to know all about Paris and the tower.
The experience was absolutely magical. The staff are wonderful and attentive and the food is amazing. The views are mind blowing. An absolute must!
It takes an hour and 10 mins, very nice cruise in the seine with exploring all the important monuments and when taking a cruise at night you can see the lights of the eiffel tour.

My family of 5 (2 teenagers and an 11yo) enjoyed the cruise tremendously. It was one of the highlights of our trip. The food was good, the live music fun and the service was good. We do not drink alcohol, but the staff provided us with all the apple juice and Coke Zero we could drink. Cruising by the Eiffel tower on a misty, rainy night, was amazing.

Although I have been to Paris many times, I had never been on a dinner cruise on the Bateaux Mouches. Because this was the first Paris visit for my travel friend, I chose this one from reading previous reviews. We thoroughly enjoyed the evening on the Panache and seeing Paris by night from the Seine. The service was excellent and our waiter YaYa made our evening even more enjoyable. The food was good, but don’t expect fine dining. Very relaxing and definitely worth the price.

It was a cold walk to Pont Alma where you get onboard your Seine River diner cruise. Walking into the office at the pier we were greeted by a smiling, “Bonjour”. From there it was a delightful experience full of delicious food, smooth wine, and pleasing music. If you want to see Paris at night, from the vantage point of the River scene, join the team at the Bateaux Mouches It will be worth your time and money.
Dinner was great and service was good. The on board entertainment was pleasant. The views are amazing and well worth the price to enjoy the river at nigh. Overall a great experience.

Okay. That title is a bit out of control but I have never in my life been to a restaurant where all the waiters smell. I walked in the place and right away picked it up and asked my wife if it was just me or did she smell it too and she confirmed she had. One server, two servers, three, four, the night went on but I didn’t have a single server come around the table without this overpowering body odor.

The food was okay. It wasn’t anything out of the ordinary, just okay. I asked if I could pay to upgrade the menu but I don’t think they spoke English but they could have grabbed someone but the server told us “That is the menu for you” and I didn’t want to argue with him.

They also forgot one of our dessert. We paid for 2, one 1 dessert arrived until the boat returned to the dock.

At any rate, if you have no other option and if you enjoy having dinner in the midst of a bunch of 19-22 year old sweaty men, please go here, otherwise, avoid this place.

We were recommended by a friend to do a dinner cruise on the Seine River and were unsure of which excursion to book as there are many dinner cruise tours. If I could give 10 stars, I would! This experience way exceeded our expectations. The food was delicious and was nicely complemented by wine and champagne. Amazing views of Paris and passing by the lit Eiffel Tower was very nice. We had a live violinist who is quite talented and made for pleasant music as we enjoyed our meal. Be aware that you only get one water bottle!

We did the evening Cruise with excellence menu - whole boat is nice - but seated on a slightly better area of the boat by going for the more expensive menu ( this also gets you a window seat guaranteed - although you may get one anyway.) Overall, we had a very memorable evening ( it was just myself and my wife). The weather was great, you could go on top deck inbetween courses and after you’d finished eating - anytime really - make sure your on top deck when passing the Eiffel Tower when light show is on - a real highlight. Food was good - service was pleasant - but staff seemed to have a lot to do - so if your expecting the same service you’d get from a top restaurant on land - you won’t, e.g. I wanted to order extra drinks - took me 5 mins to find someone to ask and then had to remind them 10 mins later - but the staff were very pleasant and I got what I wanted eventually - all in all a great evening on a lovely boat - with good food and pleasant service, my only real gripe was on arriving at Bateux Mouche - a big company with a few boats - very crowded and not sure at all where we were meant to go or what boat we were on - it turns out you have to check in - in what seemed to be the back of a bar area - you get your boarding pass and are directed to your boat - this was over 100 metres away and people queuing for a different boat - so we were confused and felt not enough signs or staff making it clear where you should go initially and then after. One last observation, which didn’t affect the cruise for us - but could have if we were sat nearer, about 10 metres away on other side of the boat - a couple had brought an older baby ( around 2 years old ) in a push chair - which was alongside their table - the kid screamed and cried for about 1 hour of the trip - we’ve all been there with kids in this scenario - but a formal dress dinner cruise where your paying over €130 per head - you don’t bring kids - you may be willing to put up with the screaming and crying - but don’t expect others who have paid a lot out for a pleasant evening to be happy with it, rant over - great cruise great night - highly recommended
It was an outstanding perfect night to celebrate the birthday of my wife. The atmosfer, the food, the scein and the service were all amazing.

We decided to do this dinner cruise for our group of total 16 people. We wanted to sit together as a group, but this would have required a set menu and cost additional money so we decided to do two groups of 8. We had a great table in the front and center of the boat. The setup was beautiful, the wait staff was amazing. The food was really good, kind of fancy but tasted great. I had the veal, those who had the fish said it was really good as well. The crab and avocado appetizer was delicious. The champagne was good and it was plenty of wine. The views from the top of the boat were beautiful as well. Overall, definitely recommend this dinner cruise.

Despite a bit of confusion about check-in time (our paperwork said it was 8 pm but when we arrived there were other indications that it might have been earlier) we were soon settled at our table at the side of the boat (tables in the centre were left unused) and set to go. 2 very good musicians appeared (one a keyboard player and the other a violinist) who accompanied our voyage throughout the evening most suitably, but there was no obvious opportunity to dance on the dance-floor in front of them as there ha been on a previous dinner-cruise many years ago, nor was there any illumination from the boat as there had been then or commentary about the places we were passing. Nevertheless it was a most enjoyable evening and to be highly recommended.
We enquired at the desk when checking in about a taxi being arranged to take us back to our hotel when we disembarked, but unlike our hotel which had been very willing to in order one to take us to the Bateaux Mouches quay at the beginning of the evening the BM staff on the dinner-cruise desk were totally unhelpful and simply told us to go and find our own cab on the nearby street when we left. We were fortunate in doing so ourselves but we left behind a number of other people still looking for taxis at 10.50 pm. This is a need that should be addressed for those not being transported by coach if 5 stars are to be earned.
Our dinner cruise was excellent staff was very friendly and I highly recommend this cruise operator.

It was a lovely way to celebrate my wife's birthday but it's a great cruise for any occasion. The view of the Eiffel Tower towards the end of the evening all lit up was wonderful. The food was very good and service very friendly and effecient. A thoroughly recommended evening out.

Our family has two teens and doing this dinner cruise was a great activity to break up the normal night routine. The service was very good, despite how busy the wait staff are. We enjoyed the music (piano playing) and all the people-watching along the Seine on a Friday night. Of course the big highlight was going to the top level and taking pictures as the Eiffel Tower lit up right as we cruised by. They have it perfectly timed! I highly recommend this with family, friends or just a fun date night. It was worth the money!

My husband and I visited Paris to celebrate our 25th Wedding Anniversary and we booked an evening dinner cruise with Bateaux Mouches as a special treat.
I can honestly say that the cruise was the highlight of our trip, apart from one upsetting incident which I will describe with more detail later.
Our boat was beautifully presented, with tables situated along the large windows, ensuring that everyone had an uninterrupted view of the scenery. Our waitress - (I regret I forget her name) - was pleasant and helpful and occasionally returned to our table to point out an interesting landmark. At one point, she even came to the upper deck of the boat where we were taking photos to tell us that our main course was about to be served.
We thoroughly enjoyed our meal. There was a choice of dishes for three courses, and also choice of wine. Everything was tasty and beautifully presented.
You can leave your table and go to the upper deck at any time and I heartily recommend that you do, as the sights and sounds of the river fully surround you. People sitting on the bank wave and call out as the boat passes by. As the sun sets, you are treated to the most amazing play of colour across the sky and on the buildings, and then it begins to get dark and the lights come on and reflect on the water. It's truly magical and I can honestly say that my camera has never clicked so much as when we approached the Eiffel Tower and it began to twinkle!
The dinner cruise was, in our opinion, worth every penny and we would do it again without hesitation if we ever visit Paris again. But here I must explain my reason for dropping one star from this review.
Throughout the meal a photographer visited the tables, taking photos of the guests. Later on, he returned with three photos - two in colour and one in black and white - which he was offering for sale. We liked one of the colour photos and purchased it, along with another copy which we planned to give to my mother. The photographer took our payment, made a note for himself about our request for another copy on the back of our purchased photo and took it and the others away.
However, as our boat docked at the end of the cruise, we realised he hadn't returned with our photos so we asked our waitress to find him. He returned with all the photos from the cruise and went through them until he found the one we had purchased. However, he then asked us to pay for it again and didn't seem to believe that we had also asked and paid for another copy. My husband can speak enough French to get by in a normal conversation, but found himself out of his depth when faced with this situation, so we were relieved when our waitress noticed that something was wrong and came to help. My husband explained the situation to her and she translated to the photographer, but he was clearly not happy and began to get more and more irate. In the end, he was obviously not prepared to print off another photo for us, so our waitress asked us to take one of the others. We didn't really like either of the other photos, but we just wanted the awful confrontation to be over, so we agreed. The photographer put the photo into a paper frame and literally threw it across the table at us. He then marched off, obviously thinking he had just been scammed out of two photos. Our waitress apologised profusely on his behalf.
The whole situation was very upsetting and, if we hadn't had such a wonderful time, could well have ruined the whole cruise. But the good points far outweighed the bad and, if we ever cruise with Bateaux Mouches again, we will remember not to ask for extra photos.
When we returned to our hotel, we noticed that there was no writing on the back of the photo, so this was clearly the copy he had printed off for us. I like to think that he subsequently found the one he had made a note for himself on and I hope he felt truly ashamed at the way he treated us.

We thoroughly enjoyed this dinner cruise, the views of Paris were amazing, the staff were good but the food was average which we expected so it was no big surprise.
It was good to be able to go up to the top deck in between courses to take some great photos. The only dissappointment was that we were first on the boat but were still allocated a table up the back of the boat as all the seating was pre arranged.

This trip is a must very romantic and the attention on the cruise we excellent. We celebrated my 50th birthday there and they bring you a cake and the violinist came and played the song my husband asked for. The food we vey good too. We highly recommend this cruise

Took this cruie for my honeymoon/birthday and overall it was ok. The wine and appetizers were good. My husband and I got two different main course meals (I got veal with potatoes and he got pork with a potato pancake with beetroot). Both meals pretty much tasted the same. The gravy on the veal tasted like Campbell's gravy in a jar. The desserts were also lackluster. The best part of the cruise was the view of the light show at the Eiffel tower and discovering different groups of people dancing and eating by the Seine (we did this the night following the cruise). I would have preferred just a regular night cruise as the food wasn't worth it.

We sat at our table for 45 minutes before being served drinks while a group showed up at the last minute and were served before we were. We had 4 at our table and half of us received our food and the remaining food came at least 10 minutes later. Clearly understaffed. The view was beautiful but the service and food was very disappointing.
We had a wonderful time. Food was very good, the music was great, the boat itself was lovely! Highly recommended!

Our group of five arrived and were immediately led to our table aboard the JS Mouche and each served a glass of champagne to start the evening. The service was very attentive without being overwhelming. The food was very good, although as I've learned before, some cheeses are definitely an acquired taste. We chose the Prestige dinner menu at 99 Euro each versus the regular menu at 79 and were pleased with the results. The departure at 8:00 PM was perfectly timed to get us a spectacular view of the Eiffel Tower at dusk fully lighted. I give Bateaux Mouches my highest recommendation.

Once onboard the ship the dinner was good, not great (but need to remember on dinner cruise ship), included bottle of wine for two (wine also OK, but we're in France-why not better). Environment was also nice, not too crowded and all were window tables. Live music was nice. Cruise on the Seine River was really nice, saw all of the wonders and beauty of Paris. I would likely go again.
Now for the pre-cruise experience. Arrival at the port, check-in and parking (esp) all terrible. Not organized, managed or structured at all (important to remember 5 ship with approx. 200 passengers each and a couple of restaurant). Between a stream of tour buses and MANY cars, nothing less than insane (very disappointing).

This was an amazing dinner cruise. The food was great! The service was awesome! But what really makes it awesome is that the boat goes right up in front of the Eiffel tower right when it lights up and blinks - it was surreal to see! The only thing I'd recommend is for there to be announcements when the boat is passing by things (like a tour guide) - since it's dark, it's not real clear. Definitely recommend this as a MUST DO!

It was fantastic! Thank you very much! It's the best thing to do in Paris. Super food. Super evening! You won't waste your money!

Es war fantastisch! Vielen Dank! Das beste was man in Paris machen kann. Super Essen. Super Abend!
Es ist sein Geld wert!

Merci

This was our second time with Bateaux Mouches Dinner and River Cruises. It is a wonderful experience. The food is outstanding and the wait staff is very pleasant and engaging. However the true event is the the city herself. There is nothing more beautiful than Paris at night, perhaps the only thing that would make it better is a light rain or a dusting of snow to finish her evening attire. This dinner and river cruise was the perfect ending to our vacation. I love Paris all 40+ times I have been there and will continue to return.

We reserved the boat with 2 months in advance and were able to secure entry in one of the most popular rides which include live music, dinner, and drinks. The boat we scheduled was sold out however, there are other options available if you run into this situation offering cheaper deals with fewer items. The menu per person was about 85 euros and it consists off: 1 glass of Castel Mouche, Appetizer (Selection of Bloc de Foie Gras, Pate with onion, Tartar of Salmon over milhojas, bizon meat with avocado and lime, cold soup with green beans and goat cheese), 1 entry (selection of round veal with vegetables, chicken with vegetables, ROund beef with Colbert sauce, white tune with olive oil and vegetables, and vegetables with barley from the area) , 1 dessert (selection of creme brulee, Mascarpone with berries, charlottine, exotic coulis, ice cream, berry sufle, and chocolate tart with English sauce), and 1 bottle of wine (Petit Chablis, La Chablisienne Chateau Taurin). We were celebrating my wife birthday and it was the perfect celebration! Strongly recommend that you make friends with the waiters and performers - it will make your night more pleasant! For sure you will be ended up buying more wine.

Thoroughly enjoyed our evening dinner cruise along the Seine River. The dinner and live music cruise is that later of the two evening cruises. A great way to see Paris at night and enjoy the residents of Paris sitting on the banks of the river dining and dancing. Music was great, food could have been a little better, the staff was excellent , very attentive and our waitress got us a cab at the end of the evening so our table of 6 didn't have to walk up to the street and wait. Overall worth the price, I would recommend Bateaux Mouches.

Went on this as an evening event during a conference, not sure I’d have paid the money for it otherwise.

We waited to board for ages while they called the register basically. We took up almost a whole boat so there were a lot of us. We had champagne on arrival and canapés - awful unless you like mashed fish. Soup was either more fish or courgette soup - which was meant to be hot but wasn’t.

Main course was served but they didn’t have enough choice so if you were at the end of the boat you just got what you were given - even if it was meat and you were veggie. Awful.
Then we had the two smallest pieces of cheese ever. And a dessert - again no choice even though the menu said there was.
Followed by coffee or tea but milk on the boat - seriously, no milk.

Two saving graces - lots of decent wine flowing all night, and Paris. The scenery along the Seine is lovely, even at night.

Do the boat - don’t get ripped off for the meal.

Walked our way through all the famous icons Concorde, Arch D'triumph, Champs Élysées. The ring road traffic was now insane. But we managed to find our way to the Port de la Concorde on the river just on dusk. (Lots of choices but we chose Bateaux Mouches for which we had tickets for the late evening dinner cruise). An unexpected reception area and embarked the boat fully enclosed with glass.
We began with a glass of champagne followed by the very nice 4 course dinner and lovely bottle of red. The piano and violin players began playing the old classics - Last Waltz, Lara's theme etc. Amazing to be serenaded in this environment and it felt surreal. We passed other boats and barges fixed and floating, people lining the banks of the river, eating their picnics, sometimes they were dancing and waving to us as we passed by. It was just a lovely boat ride at dusk in a beautiful cities. Truly memorable.

The view throughout the stay in the cruise was fantastic, but the food was literally horrible .
We've already reserved for the €130 meal per person, but the steak feels cheap and dry, just like the cheapest one u can get from tesco. The only service that I feel good was the waiter who helped to serve our table.
Overall I would not have another meal in this cruise again, but if u really wanna go, just pick the cheapest meal available.

We enjoyed this trip very much. The service was excellent, and the food was quite good. There were several courses, and we had good options for each course. There is definitely something to please just about anyone. We enjoyed cruising along the river as we dined, seeing so many famous bridges and getting glimpses of various sights. Remember to go up to the top deck (if it isn't raining) to take some pictures with the Eiffel Tower or other landmarks in the background.

This was a great way to enjoy Paris if you've never been. The boat is very nice, the cruise allows plenty of picture-taking and the live music was fantastic! Only thing holding this back from 5-stars was the food was just ok. Not that you're expecting 5-star food, but for the price I was a bit disappointed.

My husband and I did this on our last night in Paris. It was our favorite thing that we did while in the city, the food is wonderful, the music fantastic, the service great. We'd seen all the sights in the city by that point - but seeing them from the river was fantastic. This was incredibly romantic and I can't recommend enough for couples.

I have a tendency to get sea sick while on boats and I didn't experience this in the least - it's a very smooth ride and the boat has great amenities outside of the good food and music (good onboard bathrooms).

I will say that if booked through TripAdvisor it was a little confusing to figure out where exactly to board the boat (there are multiple that take off from the same pier), but once inside the pier a very nice attendant helped us.

If ever back in Paris, we'll do this again.

I have to congratulate the staff and management for making a memorable evening for my wife who was celebrating her 50th birthday. The organisation was highly professional and welcoming. Everything went perfectly. The waitress who looked after us was responsive and even brought a small cake with two candles at the end of our meal. Every table has a window view on this cruise. I would recommend this attraction to anyone with a similar celebration.

We took this cruise 30 years ago on our honeymoon - it was fantastic!!! We booked the cruise for a birthday, remembering our earlier experience. Boy, we're we wrong!!! The service was non-existent - we were served one miniscule glass of champagne never to see the bottle or waiter again until he took our order never to show-up again until the boat landed and he was looking for a tip!! The food was a crime in France!! My fillet was tough and stringy and my wife's lamb was 40% fat.

The only site lit was the Eiffel Tower - all other building lights along the Seine were out! When the boat landed after the cruise, there are no taxis available!!! My wife and I lucked out - after walking up to the street level - waiting for 20 minutes - an off duty cab took pity on us due to the fact my wife walks with a cane!!

At a cost of 138€ per person, you are better off going to a good restaurant and enjoying yourself!

Everything is very nice we have a beautiful night
The river view is very interesting and the live music too

Disappointing service on this cruise the couple beside us weren’t asked for their food order until about 15 minutes into the cruise, the food was very mediocre at €100 per person, there was one bottle of wine between 2 people but only one bottle between 4 on a table of 4 which seemed a little miserable. Also a word of warning just be careful when getting transport afterwards we got on one of the motorised Tuk Tuks and agreed a price when we arrived at our hotel the driver attempted to intimidate us but telling us the prices were per person ( he changed the laminate sign shortly before we arrived at our hotel when he needed to restart the tuk tuk) he became very aggressive and we threatened to call the police before he left shouting and cursing at us)

I booked this evening for 4 people, we arrived in Paris midday, and were staying right by the Eiffiel Tower, so not far from Bateaux Mouches. We set out at 6pm as we thought it would be busy, we had absolutely no instructions from the company, on how to get to Pont De l'Alma. It was the 14th July, Bastille in Paris, and the Police had shut all roads and bridges. We had police shouting at us, even though we were showing our paperwork. This evening cost us 720 €, we tried phoning the company and emailed before departure, and since arriving back in the uk, and not even a courtesy email has been sent back. This is appalling behaviour from a Company, it completely ruined our trip and we feel robbed, The company should have clear instructions and a pick up piont on a evening such as this.
It was so cool! They had great food and there was no movement inside the boat from the waves although the seine did stink a little bit outside haha

Lovely experience - food was very good and the trip took in all the sights.
Was extremely hot but a/c seemed not to have much effect !
An amazing experience, thank you - great welcome, delicious food, bubbles, friendly staff and what views! Great intro to Paris!!
A happy evening with great energy and service-food was just right- views best if you step up top. Musicians were delightful
The hostess was not very smily, the tour very very nice, the food just OK but the service and the music were excellent
Absolutely fabulous experience warm welcoming and efficient staff, lovely relaxing cruise on a classy boat and the best food

Fabulous experience that exceeded my expectations on this Dinner River Cruise

Amazing staff and food

Worth every penny! Very smart boat and the staff were delightful! We were 3 adults but still got a bottle of champagne and a bottle of wine! The food exceeded my expectations too. All in all a lovely evening.
Thanks to Moussa for his service during this amazing diner good food, good moment and good place view eiffel tower seine river and music so nice
I was booked for a dinner cruise in April, but due to events the Company was not operating. Why have I still not received a refund???

We celebrated our wedding anniversary on the boat and it was great. The food was good and there were definitely enough enough dishes to choose from. The staff was friendly and attentive. The music was also a nice touch. The views from the boat were amazing. The only complaint is that due to water levels we were unable to go down to the Louvre and Norte Dame area....this was due to rain earlier in day and all week. All in all we had a wonderful time.
Loved the whole experience, expensive but well worth it.Food, views and the staff all helped the us have a great time.
A delightful way to see the sights of Paris at night and have a lovely meal with wonderful music! Very efficiently run with great staff!
Very good service! It was my boyfriend birthday and I ask for candles with the desert and the song for happy birthday and they helped with the surprise. We had a great time. I totally recommend.

Excellent
Last minute booking due to our planning but worth it
Great atmosphere in the boat, ta Ke service was splendid, very good food start to finish, total no rush atmosphere
External views of the city between courses and our waiters kindly gathered us up before food was sat going cold-top marks
The violinist was exceptional, not something you have the pleasure of hearing very often

My husband and I did this cruise for our anniversary and it was our favorite activity while on vacation. The view was beautiful, and the service, wine and food were all excellent. The whole experience was very romantic. I definitely recommend this cruise!

It was one of the worst experiences which i ever had, they didnt specify a waiter for our table , all other tables had food on them, but on ours they just startes getting our order. After a long waiting time, they brought all our foods wrong, we ordered lobster and they served us chicken. I was really disappointed for 130euro that i paid to them for each if us. The service was terrible.
The cruise was unbelievable. Great food. Piano player and violinist that were awesome. Seeing the city all lit up at night was amazing. Highlight of our trip.
Best way to spend your anniversary! Amazon service, food and music! The top view decks was really good for photos too!

We spent 45 minutes running along the piers trying to find where the boat was docked. The location was not clear on the website or the ticket. When we finally made it on with 2 minutes to spare we were immediately seated and attended to. The service was great: appetizer, main course, dessert and wine, and there was a live band playing throughout the cruise. Overall we had a great time.
A good value trip, very memorable with awesome sights.Not greatly responsive to food issues though, care if you are lactose or gluten intolerant.
Ideal for a romantic dinner. Delicious food much better than expected and the perfect way to see paris by night.Everythinh was as described and even more!
This was one of the highlights of our trip. It was classy, elegant, romantic and so fun. Definitely something I would recommend to future Paris travelers.

This is a really lovely experience and a wonderful way to see an unexpected side of paris. The food was surprisingly good. We combined it with the crazy horse cabaret club package which made for a really special night. The only thing to let it down was the waiting around before you could board the boat. If the would just maybe open the bar it would have been so much better

It was a cold evening in Paris and we were just hoping to stay warm on the water. We were so pleasantly surprised by the lovely bar area, which was very comfortable and set the mood for an amazing 2 hour cruise. We thoroughly enjoyed everything from the food, to the drinks, to the service and the lovely music that made the voyage extra special. We were quite cozy at our window table and needed no scarves or jackets to stay warm. Will definitely tell friends visiting Paris that this is a must "do."

We very much enjoyed the river cruise with Bateaux Mouches and feel it is one of the best based on others we saw and even past during our cruise. The boat was very well maintained and staffed making for a nice evening. The music was pleasant and appropriate allowing for conversation even while hearing the duo play. The only reason I did not make this a five star is we both felt the meal was average at best, there were nice options and a number of courses but the main course, again was only average. If not for the cost we might have had lower expectations and felt differently. Overall though, well worth going.
Great time, good food and a beautiful cruise but the wine should have been better - after all - this is France!

We took the 8:00 pm Bateaux Mouches cruise. We've boated on the Seine before in earlier trips, but this was far and away our best boating experience. The dock is easy to find; every taxi driver in Paris knows it. Our ship was new and modern, and the staff was polite, helpful, and fluent in English. A highlight was the live music--especially the violinist. We ate and drank very well. The pilot timed our cruise perfectly, arriving at the Eiffel Tower at exactly 10:00 pm for the evening light show. It was more expensive than some other cruises but well worth it.

My partner and I booked this package as part of our trip to Paris. Finding the location was easy and boarding was quick and easy. We were shown to our seats at the front (best seats in the house) our waiter was fantastic, very friendly. The food however was not the 5 star I expected considering we opted for the excellence menu. My boyfriend had the scallops to which his portion was quite small and food slightly tasteless. The scenery and the fact that we saw the Eiffel light up as passed made up for the food. I wouldn’t however pick this food option again the cruise yes! 🇫🇷

Definitely the best time to go is early or mid October. The weather was great, not too cold not too hot. Having dinner during the afternoon and seeing the sunset was an amazing experience. The boat is very nice, the staff is very friendly, and the food is great.
This is an absolute must for couples that want a genuine Paris romantic evening! Great food, incredible hosts & very romantic atmosphere. We would do this again and again.

It was a real treat to get dressed up and see Paris by night in this fabulous boat but a little commentary on what we were passing would have been appreciated. The wait staff were all attentive and pleasant and the food, although not amazing, was plentiful and tasty with lots of wine and even a glass of decent champagne to start with. I’d definitely recommend this trip for a special treat.

We had a fantastic night with great service and food. It was my daughters 21st birthday and they made her feel extra special with the lighting of her cake and sang happy birthday to her. Would thoroughly recommend this great experience.

Great food, excellent service, well worth the cost. Suggest arriving early for a cocktail at the bar. Monuments reflect in the evening were beautiful. Wait staff was helpful but not obtrusive. Boat was very calm and enjoyable. We danced to the live music. Uber provided easy transportation for our hotel. Highly recommend.

We had group of 6 and we all had an excellent dinner and it was the highlight of our stay in Paris. 5 of us had the pork loin which was very good, crab appetizer good, veal dinner just OK, cheese excellent, dessert excellent. Service was excellent. 1 bottle of wine per couple. Overall excellent price for cruise, meal, wine and live music. Boat was less then half full, plenary of time to go up top between courses to see the sights. Seeing the Eiffel Tower twinkling was something I will never forget. Highly recommend this cruise as our whole group had a wonderful experience. Our server was Letifah and she was so pleasant.

My wife and I were celebrating our golden wedding anniversary that evening. The food was good but unfortunately everything else was not. The lounge was overcrowded and VERY noisy, it reminded me of a youngsters stag trip. The service was terrible and we had docked and were still awaiting two courses which my wife has to ask for. This should have been an evening to remember unfortunately it will remain in our memory as a disaster.
Excellent value for money. Really good food and drinks. The is also love music on board, I would do it again!

Perfect for a couple or w group to have a beautiful evening together enjoying the scenic beauties of Paris.
Separate table and well organized. Totally worth.

We can’t say enough about how we were treated by the staff. My fiancée has mobility issues that have her in a wheelchair, and they were very helpful. Unfortunately, our boat had mechanical problems and we didn’t leave the dock. We were given the choice to leave for a full refund, even though we had already had champagne, amuse bouches and appetizers. Or we could stay, and take a night cruise along the Seine after dinner on another boat. For this option, they offered us a 30% refund. Luckily, our table still had a view of the Eiffel Tower and lights sparkling off the Seine. The meal was absolutely delicious. By the end of the meal, my fiancée was too tired to take the cruise. We were offered tickets for any other evening, and they arranged to have a taxi pick us up right beside the boat for our comfort. Every member of the staff performed over and above expectations. We will be back!

We were all around Paris and ended our week Friday night with this cruise and couldn’t be happier! Having champagne on the top of a boat at sunset looking out over Paris was beautiful and the service was great, I looked like a genius for this pick.

Cruise itself was lovely, boat was comfortable, clean and smooth. Staff were very professional and pleasant.

Food was disappointing, very ‘average’ in quality, waiting for up to an hour between courses.

Entertainment was so loud you could not easily have a conversation (we were at the opposite end of the boat). As a nice dinner cruise this spoiled the atmosphere.

All in all the cruise was nice, over priced and spoiled by mediocre food and excessively loud music.

This was one of the highlights of our week in Paris. We were concerned the food would be sub par, but it was all very good. The service was excellent and the views from the top of the boat were amazing. So glad we did this!

Good dinner
Excellent service
Best view of Paris
Nice people on board
And
Perfect summer evening weather

Perfect way for us to spend our last night in Paris. The staff were awesome. Music was perfect and the cruise was timed to hit the Eiffel Tower as it began to sparkle. So beautiful. The only downside was that the meat was a little over cooked. Some of us had the beef..too well done. The pork tenderloin as well. Still did not take away from the evening. Great time and I would recommend it.

One of the best nights of our lives !! Went with Adult children and we just loved it . Food was great , music was fitting for ride , service was fantastic! Unbelievable views , eat and go up on top and take pictures at anytime!

We took the sunset river cruise during our short visit to Paris. We really enjoyed the sights and tour on the water. My teenage daughter wasn't crazy about the food, but it was good. The wine was tasty and the service was excellent. Highly recommend the sunset cruise which will take you right past the Eiffel Tower at the end where it is all lit up and looking beautiful.

It was a spectacular ending to our Mother daughter trip! Service was great. Music was beautiful. Dinner was amazing. Closed in with air conditioning but views were spectacular from every table. Upstairs was open air.
Timing is everything, we had the best waiter YAYA! He moved up to the font of the boat, which was the best view. The food was great and you couldn't beat the view while eating. Just A great time

Wonderful experience!!! We celebrated my granddaughter's 16th birthday and she was so happy!! Dinner was delicious, the Eiffel Tower twinkle lights were magical and we even saw a marriage proposal on the boat. A definite experience to enjoy in Paris!!!

Spent a fantastic night dining on the river for my fiancée’s 30th. The reception was warm and the food really delicious. Our waiter Moussa was great, very attentive and made the night unforgettable for our group.

The boat passes all the main sights and it was very romantic cruising along the river at sunset. I can’t recommend it more highly and it really is a must-do when visiting Paris!

The food and service were surprisingly good. Almost everyone
had a window table. The check in process before getting on the boat can use some work. Overall, very much enjoyed it.

what an amazing experience! We were only in Paris for one day and thought this would be a great way to see as much as possible while having a nice dinner. It exceeded our expectations. The food was fantastic and the wine was too! We started with champagne and enjoyed the many courses and live music. We were able to see the Eiffel tower lit up at night and could go to the top of the boat to take photos as well. It as a lovely night and one of the best things we could have done.

Our dinner cruise was our first activity in Paris and provided beautiful evening views of the areas we would become acquainted with over the week. We sat a forward table, which I recommend. The food was very good, our young waiter was friendly and attentive, and the music was excellent. We took several trips upstairs to the top level, which not all dinner cruises have, to enjoy the sparkling Paris night. We had a great time!
Good food, great views, unique experience along the Seine river at night . The live music was a nice touch,

Six of us had a great time on our dinner cruise. We were not disappointed by the experience. The food was above average. A little disappointed that the cruise was over before our food service. Tip: Arrange a car service for the conclusion. There were no taxis available.

I asked the hotel concierge to find us a nice dinner cruise and the booked us on the Bateaux Mouches we arrived 20 minutes before the boat left and were seated with a large beam right in front of our view, even though there were better seats available. we did get a nice glass of champagne and that's about where the good service ended. For some reason we were the last ones to get served on just about everything, when we got our starters, practically every one else was finishing their main course, the waiter brought us our wine and just left the bottle on the table, no bread and the literally brought our dessert as the boat docked. I'd have not been quite so disappointed had I not seen that we bought the top end plan. I will say the music was wonderful and I suspect the food would have been great had it not been room temperature by the time we were served.

5 years ago we had a great evening on this dinner cruise, so we wanted to repeat it now. I checked our photos of the food after our return now, and I can confirm: it's not just the merry memories - food was genuinely good back then. Not now, unfortunately.

We went for the Prestige menu, but I don't think the quality would be much different for the other menu. Our starter was OK. Our main courses however... I had a fish, which was way below average. My wife had veal, and portions of it she just couldn't chew... Her dauphine potatoes were obviously prepared a long time ago - they had that typical texture and color...

The cheese selection was two pieces of semi-hard cheese; nothing special at all if you tasted more than 5 kinds of cheese in your life before...

The dessert was again OK, and so was the champagne and the wine, to be fair.

The aircon was unnecessarily strong, quite disturbing especially after sunset.

The view and the route itself is spectacular, although going out all the way towards Bercy is rather unnecessary - but maybe this is how the arrival at the Eiffel tower at exactly 22:00 to see the light show can be timed precisely.

THe check-in procedure is complicated too, with a restaurant and a bar all having queues at the same place and clear signs missing.
A wonderful un-rushed dinner with excellent entertainment in a marvellous ambient atmosphere. Friendly and welcoming staff who make the evening most enjoyable and memorable.

From the moment we stepped into the reception area until the end of the cruise the service and meals were superb.
We were recommended this by our Airbnb host and weren't disappointed.
All the tables were facing the windows unlike some other River cruises we saw that seemed to crowd people in,there is plenty of room to move about upstairs to get great photos.
All in all a fantastic experience.
A wonderful way to see Paris at night! Start to finish, everything was well organized and the service was excellent!

Beyond expectations and a real treat! Professionally run, beautiful food, excellent service and lovely live violin music. The boat travelled at the perfect speed to allow one to feel relaxed, to appreciate the beautiful sights and drink in the atmosphere. Seating is arranged along the glass sides of the boat, allowing stunning views during the whole trip. There is also easy access to the roof for even better viewing between courses. Can't recommend this experience enough! Thank you Bateaux Mouche and your fabulous team of staff for a really magical evening !!

We took the 8.30pm cruise along the river, had an absolutely gorgeous view from our table. The team sorted out my food so that it was vegan (obviously meaning I skipped the cheese course) both of us (my husband is not vegan) really enjoyed all the food and it was in such a relaxed atmosphere. We bought an extra bottle of wine at 30 euros wasn't too bad at all. The musicians came along for requests towards the end of the cruise and it was a total highlight of our trip, the best being the Tower which started to sparkle just as we passed it. We saw a lot of boats up and down the Seine but this definitely looked like one of the better ones.

I booked this for my fiancé and I along with my parents and we had a wonderful time!! The check in and boarding process was well organized and the interior of the boat very nicely appointed. The service was fantastic and so friendly and the food was quite good!! Champagne was served to start along with an amuse bouche and the portions were perfect.
I was really pleasantly surprised as I know some of these cruises can be lack luster and a bit tacky but this was was great!! We loved the live music and the views and I would recommend this to anyone for a fun experience during a trip to Paris!

We bought the Dinner cruise and it was worth every minute. We spent a lovely evening, enjoying the food, the views, the live music, and the wine. This is a cruise to sit back and enjoy the night with whoever your there.
If you are looking for a guided tour with someone talking to you about the buildings around this is not for you.
Also, if you are a connoisseur or food critic maybe you are also better off going to a nice restaurant. I only say this because before going I read a bunch of reviews stating the food was not good so naturally we were a little hesitant about buying this cruise but to us the food was fine. We were a party of four and everyone enjoyed the food and the whole experience very much.

To be honest I did not expect a lot of this cruise but I loved it, the service was good, I am a bit picky in regards to food, but the food was good. After enjoying our food we were able to go out and enjoy the sights, it was really romantic.
Lovely service! Good food and atmosphere! This made it the perfect place for my boyfriend to propose!

Booking was very efficient no issues.
We payed the extra for the more choise menu.
We were seated at the front of the boat which has Perspex glass around it this is for safety I can understand that but if you want to take pictures or a video Perspex is a nightmare especially if it’s scratched. The sides of the boat have glass and clear so if you have a table along the length of the boat you will be fine.
The food was fine for us we had steak for main course, I had frogs legs for starter my wife had the salmon.
We are not into sweets really so had the cheese selection instead which was lovely.
The price was included a bottle of wine which we had the red which was fine.
As it was Christmas and as a treat we also had a bottle of Champagne, but you do get a complementary glass of Champagne when you are seated at your table.
We very much enjoyed the experience although the night we went the weather was fine rain and at one point the Eiffel Tower looked more like a light house due to the fine rain and missed.🤣
We would still recommend the trip you do get looked after well and for anyone worried about eating on a boat or feeling sea sick it is very stable and you don’t get the movement you would on the open sea ship.
Try it.

This was my first time in Paris so my family and I wanted a laid back way to see some of the sights the city offers. The Bateaux Mouches River cruise was recommended by friends so we gave it a try. The entire experience was wonderful. It was the perfect length where we felt we had enough time to appreciate our surrounding and yet did not feel like it was dragging on. The food was made well. The staff was very accommodating and the whole process was very streamlined. My family and I will definitely do this again!

This trip is highly recommended for value and experience. The food , atmosphere and service were excellent. Seeing all the sights from the river whilst dining was great and it was capped off coming towards the end when we sailed passed the Eiffel Tower lit up in all it's splendour with gold light and sparkling white lights one word MAGICAL

if you go to Paris you have to do this! this is by far one of the best experiences of my life. We did the 8:30 pm cruise with dinner. and the Food was to die for, the service was out of this world and the band was amazing. You could not fault it one bit. You have to experience this its everything you expect and more!
What a great way to see Paris. Nice view of Paris lights. Food was plentiful with a full bottle of wine
Would go again, however food was just okay could have been warmer, we were lucky the weather was top notch all in all an enjoyable evening would try it again.

We did the dinner cruise with live music on our last night in Paris! It was the perfect day to end our trip! Food was good, staff very friendly and the music very relaxing!
Make sure to go to the top/deck for the best pictures of the Eiffel Towers and the light show!

The weather was perfect. My daughter and I were treated like royalty. Everyone had a window seat.The four course meal was delicious. The piano and violin set the proper mood for the cruise. Lots of time to go to the upper deck to see the sights and take pictures. Perfect ending to our first full day in Paris.

My husband, 26 year-old son and myself had a very delightful evening on this dinner cruise. We thought it was money well spent. The food and service were wonderful. We had a great view from our table and later we went on the upper deck to see the sparkling of the Eiffel Tower at 10pm. The cruise was timed perfectly to be in position for this amazing moment. We snapped a bunch of photos and relished this outing in The City of Lights.

Absolutely romantic and amazing. Delicious dinner and friendly staff. I recommend taking the cruise where they include 3 dish dinner and wine. If you are going to Paris as a couple, this should be on your "to do" list.

You should be getting your money worth as this is not cheap, but at the end you feel good. The food is good, not excellent, but good quality and a big selection. The drinks are fine and you can always top of with a la carte wines or other. The entertainment was good and added atmosphere and happiness - the reason you go is the setting and that is worth the trip. Stunning Paris Riversides and buildings with an Eiffel Tower finale as the cherry on the top.
Great view of northern dame, orsay and Eiffel Tower. Leisurely. Seemed like the Bateaux Mouche was one of the nicer ships

We booked a table for 3 the day before we went and as my mother put it, it was a once in a lifetime experience.

The staff alone is enough to give this cruise a 5 star rating, they all went out of their way to treat guests with kindness(especially Bush, he was the absolute best waiter we've ever had!!)

The food was pretty good. We've had better but we all agree only food-wise it was a 3/5, the atmosphere and the staff is what makes this dinner experience so great.

The 2 hours and 15 min was perfect as well, we didn't feel like we were in a rush to eat before leaving(picked this cruise as the others seemed too short).

The cheese platter was so yummy as well!

The Seine is known as the City of Light's most beautiful street. A night time cruise is the ideal way to see the attractions beautifully lit. Dinner with champagne and wine is part of the package price
The food was delicious and we loved the charming violinist and piano player. Waiter wasn’t very nice
It was a terrific experience. Everyone was extremely polite and professional. The music was great and the food was good, seeing the sights in Paris at night was very special!
Great thing to do and see the City of Lights by night. The food was great and immensely enjoyed the live music - definitely recommend!!

Staff was all amazing and kind! Food was amazing and overall such a fun experience!! This is definitely something I would do again and will recommend to all my friends. My friend and I did it for a girls night but it’s honestly great for any occasion! I was a little worried beforehand it wouldn’t be enough food but definitely come with a healthy appetite!
Romantic dinner cruise with great food, music and staff. They even play music for people celebrating anniversaries and birthdays.
The service, the music and the backdrop of the lights of Paris made the trip memorable. It was a nice atmosphere within the dinner cruise.
Night cruise….great seeing Paris at night from the Seine. Food a service were great! Would recommend to others.
the music and service were absolutely incredible this was one of the highlights of my paris trip fantastic
Had a fabulous time , thank you. I will sure come back again with my children . You made my Paris experience more enjoyable
This cruise didn’t disappoint. Wonderful service and great views of Paris at night. The only bad part was getting a taxi after the cruise was finished.
Atmosphere is great. Personnel is friendly, doing their best. Food is really average, however general impression is quite positive and worthwhile.
Food was surprisingly great! Not what we were expecting. The service was great too. Illumination views were beautiful.

One of the highlights of our trip to Paris.
The boat is nicely done, service is great, food is great, live music is great and the view.
Higly recomended

Needed to change my booking due to illness. I tried calling and calling the company about 10 times the and nobody answered my calls I wasn't able to reschedule and lost all of my money. Extremely dissatisfied

A MUST do experience in Paris🌹🌹🌹💕💕. Despite the tourist vibe, it is worth the experience and exposure to Paris at night. Eiffel Tower is mesmerizing especially when the lights start flashing on the hour.
This was by far the best dinner cruise I have ever attended. The boat was beautiful, the staff very friendly and professional and the food outstanding. Seeing the Eiffel tower by night is a must!

It was an excellent cruise. Great food, wonderful music and beautiful sites. I wasn't sure what to expect from the food but it was very delicious. The desserts and wine amazing! This cruise was one of our favorite activities we did in Paris. Definitely a magical experience.
Excellent location...clean hotel. Double Room was small I thought. But I guess that's the normal size here.

Amazing

Food was fantastic with excellent service
Great atmosphere
Wonderful
This little boat made our trip and the was the best part of our trip
We feel inlove with each other all over again due to the magnificence
Highly recommended

Absolutely the best way to spend my last night in Paris!! The staff is friendly, professional and very helpful. The food was amazing; esp the unlimited French champagne and bottle of Bordeaux wine!! It wasn’t raining; the sights were breathtaking, esp the Eiffel Tower all lit up and sparkling gold!! Well worth it!!

The cruise was great! Only issue is the food while great offered some different types of food we weren’t at all used to as Americans and didn’t want to try on a dinner cruise. That was more on us than the company. Service was great.
Food overall good but some better choices of warm vegetarian choices in starter & main would have complimented for vegetarian people. Also red wine choices could be better.
Not really anything to add to other reviews. The Cruise was excellent providing great views. Good service, particularly from a young waiter, Chris. Food was ok. All in all, a worthwhile experience.
This is one of the best ways to see Paris by night. The diner was delicious. Well Wirth the money. We highly recommend this river cruise o the Seine.
Beautiful, relaxing cruise w amazing views. Dinner was very good and service was excellent. The night cruise route enhanced views of many attraction from the vantage of the river

Absolutely brilliant! My husband and I celebrated our first wedding anniversary and had the most magical experience! If you go in the evening, make sure you are outside at 10pm to see the EiffelTower lit up beautifully. We saw things in Paris we’d have missed if we hadn’t done this cruise
Incredible views, exemplary and knowledgeable staff. Very clean, full service experience, and the food is worth every penny!
This is an exceptional dinner cruise. Food was great, the views along the River were fantastic and beautiful views of the Eiffel Tower!! Easy access to the boat and efficient checkin.
Wonderful views. Decent food. Decent service. Very nice music. Highly recommend. Cocktails other than wine would have been nice.

The tour was great, and being able to see the Eiffel Tower at night was great! Unfortunately I got food poisoning from the food, that ruined my next day in Paris. I wish we had just done a tour and ate at a proper restaurant.
Everything was wonderful; the food, the service, the music, and oh my the views of nighttime in Paris were amazing! I so recommend this, it was one of our highlights of being in Paris.
Terrible service and not that entertaining. They gave us the worst table as well, all food was late or cold. Just walk the city. Fake luxury here.
Perfectly wonderful evening. The food, the views, the music, and wait staff was all exceptional. Everything ran on schedule
Great trip all round, nice staff, lovely food. Great views, good musicians, could not fault it, superb evening spent on the Seine.

The music was good .Dining servers were excellent. The food was subpar except for dessert. It was cooler on the top deck than the restaurant. Beautiful views of the lite up Eiffel tower .
.
Lovely way to see Paris, friendly staff, lovely food. Went for a special treat with my daughter and saw the Eiffel tower sparkling!
Magical evening in Paris. Food was exceptional as was the service. Paris at night is spectacular especially the Eiffel Tower. Well worth the price.
The food was excellent, the service superb, the music was too-notch. PLUS, the views from the boat were fabulous. We all loved, loved, loved it
Amazing experience! If visiting Paris I highly recommend this trip. Great food and even better service.. the views are amazing.
Best cruise ever. Food, ambient, waiter excelente, the music and see the Eiffel Tower so close what else can you ask for.
Excellent cruise! I give it 10 thumbs up. Our waiter was fantastic.. so sorry I didn’t have his name. Overall, I will take this cruise again and again and again. 💃🕺🏻

I had such an amazing time. The staff was so friendly and the vibes were amazing. It ended up raining (and a bit of thunder) during the cruise, but it added even more charm and romance to the evening. Such a great experience!
Amazing!! Everything was perfect, the music, the food, the people who work there!! A big thank you for everything!! For sure I will back.
We have a wonderful time on the cruise. The weather was perfect and the sunset and views along the river and especially the Eiffel Tower were incredible! The food was delicious!

Double booked despite table reservation for four placed 3 weeks earlier. Then would not give refund. After a number of email exchanges we finally got offered the refund. I would not recommend this company
Elegant atmosphere, excellent food, personable waiter. Pianist provided a lovely ambiance. It's all I hoped for and more. Compared to other boats passing by, ours was the queen.
This was our 3rd time on the Bateau Mouche and we were not disappointed! Fantastic cruise and would do it all over again. Fir our friends it was their first time and they loved it
We had a great time on our dinner cruise. The servers were very friendly and the scenery was beautiful. The food could have been better, but didn’t take away from the experience.
i write many mail to cancel my reservation 2 weeks before it, no answer and no refund done, orrible experience!

Great experience. Unique way to see Paris at night. Timed perfectly to see Eiffle Tower lit up. Easy to find by taxi - big sign. Our waiter and host Aghiles was great, friendly, humorous and looked after us well. Food was good, not great, but enjoyable. Adequate amount of Champaign and wine.

We took the cruise the first night in the city . It was amazing . We had the prestige package .. the food was amazing .. lovely music and great wine . The seats are great with a glass ceiling . You see everything on the river and the tower is right over you ... it is a great time

One of the highlights of my weekend trip to Paris. Great food, service and of course the many sights light up throughout the cruise.
I highly recommend this for any couple wanting to do something extra special on their trip.

Excellent night. Very easy to get on board, totally organised to perfection
Prompt embarking and sights were beautiful as the Christmas lights were twinkling

Fabulous attentive staff

Food amazing
Wonderful memories
Well worth the money.

I noticed a dip in standard this time - since a good few years ago - but definitely still worth doing. Our Sat eve prestige dinner cruise was definitely acceptable if not particularly outstanding. Late departing so first course served before moving off. Had to request dessert and also the coffee at the end...both arrived after we were berthed back again and some were disembarking. However, our special occasion was marked by a surprise sparkler and we did have a lovely round table facing each other rather than a side by side. Menu choice for me was a little disappointing - seemed to remember having steak previously- chicken / veal etc this time. All were polite, welcome small champers, a bottle of red or white and food fine. Worth doing.

Everything went smooth and perfect! Food and drinks were good. We ordered a few different drinks and paid 12 euros per drink.
The views from the city of light were awesome. We really enjoyed the boat trip and the atmosphere.

A experience to repeat!

My wife and I were a little hesitant to book this based on some previous reviews, given it’s not cheap however we bit he bullet and booked it and we certainly were not disappointed and it was worth every penny.
The previous reviews I can only assume are based on the different priced tickets and I have to say excellence is the way forward.

We booked Excellence as this is our honeymoon and wanted to splash out a little but for the money (£233) it was perfect.
Window seat, beautiful beautiful food, amazing service and saw everything along the Seine. It really was special.

We were given a glass of champagne on arrival, then a bottle of red to go with our four course dinner which was drawn out nicely, not given to you one after the other straight away, plenty of time to go up stairs and see the sites with your loved one!

Book the ticket excellence and I can assure you, you will not be disappointed, yes you are sat quite close to each other but I couldn’t hear other peoples conversations as they couldn’t hear mine! The live music is a lovely touch and were great and by the end you will be clapping and signing along!

This was certainly one of the highlights of our trip to Paris! NOTE: We're Americans, first-time to Paris. We booked online. It was very easy. And we believe worth the $$. When you arrive at Bateaux Mouches the night of the cruise, you'll check-in *BEFORE* you get on the boat. They'll guide you to the correct one. It was easy to follow, easy to understand. Just don't board the boat without checking in first. We enjoyed the cruise tremendously. It was a relaxing, enjoyable evening. We enjoyed the food. Our waitress was wonderful. We were towards the front of the boat - with a variety of folks on board (a couple that got engaged, a table full of brothers, a couple celebrating their anniversary, two couples from the States). You are allowed up to the deck, for photos, etc. The music was beautiful. Again - "highly recommended!"
Service was horrible. Food was second rate. The boat ride was nice but not worth it. I would not recommend them.

We chose to spend our last evening in Paris on the seine river. We had a table to ourselves with a great view. Our server Simon was excellent. Dinner was pretty good. A romantic end to our Paris vacation. The violinist was tremendous. You get a glass of champagne and a bottle of wine to share. Could have used one more glass each.

Very nice cozy atmosphere! What could be better to celebrate our 20th anniversary other than a romantic delicious dinner with my better half and our best friends on the cruise, surrounded by nice live music, river views and illuminated Paris views? We are absolutely happy by making this choice! Thank you.

A fantastic night from the moment we stepped on board. Ali our waiter was excellent, the food exceeded our expectations and Paris looked beautiful from the river. This was one of our favourite trips over the weekend.

We visited as a group of three for a 21st birthday and had a lovely evening. The organisation and embarkation is slick as you would expect from a company of this size and experience.
The boat was very nice inside although the heating wasn't 100% it was ok and felt warm if you went outside to take some photos then came back in!
Food was better than expected, typically French, and the service was very attentive. Seeing the lights and sights from The Seine was really nice and as has been mentioned before they time passing the Eiffel Tower perfectly!
Would definitely use again should the occasion arise.

The river cruise seems to be very popular particularly for groups celebrating something. The dinner was good but don't expect top quality. Two musicians played the whole night with piano and violin. They were professional. During the cruise, we went upstairs to see the buildings along the river. It was beautiful. Everything was well planned except the tables were all banked at the side of the boat. Depending on the size of group, the length of the table varied. For large group like us, the few people at the side of the boat just couldn't get out. The seats were also very tight, one on the back of another. The boat might have been overbooked that night.
